{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極經世書十四卷，宋邵雍撰。邵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"子數學，本於李挺之、穆修，而其源出於陳搏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"當李挺之初見邵子於百泉，即授以義理性","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"命之學。其作皇極經世，盖出於物理之學，所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"謂易外别傳者是也。其書以元經㑹，以㑹經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448309176500265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"運，以運經世，起於帝堯甲辰，至後周顯徳六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"年已未，而興亡治亂之蹟，皆以卦象推之。朱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"子謂皇極是推步之書，可謂能得其要領。朱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"子又嘗謂：自易以後，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"無人做得一物如此整","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"齊，包括得盡。又謂：康節易看了，却看别人的","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"不得。而張㟭亦謂：此書本以天道，質以人事，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"辭約而義廣，天下之能事畢矣。盖自邵子始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"為此學，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"其後自張行成、祝泌等數家以外，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448287915507727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"明其理者甚鮮，故世人卒莫窮其作用之所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"以然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"其起而議之者，則曰元㑹運世之分，無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"所依據。十二萬九千餘年之説，近於釋氏之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"刼數；水、火、土、石，本於釋氏之地、水、火、風。且五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"行何以去金、去木？乾在易為天，而經世為日；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"兑在易為澤，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"以至離之為星，震","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"之為辰，坤之為水，艮之為火，坎之為土，巽之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"為石，其取象多不與易相同，俱難免於牽強","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448295792427042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"不合。然邵子在當日用以占驗，無不竒中，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"厯代皆重其書。且其自述大㫖，亦不專於象","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"數。如云：天下之事，始過於重，猶卒於輕；始過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"於厚，猶卒於薄。又云：學以人事為大。又云：治","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"生於亂，亂生於治，聖人貴未然之防，是謂易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"之大綱。又云：天下將治，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

PageId":"7426448590589018175"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1047,"lineType":1,"content":"復奔曲沃。晉人及虢侯立翼侯子光，是謂哀侯。鄭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1049,"lineType":1,"content":"伐宋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1051,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之寅二千二百一十一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1053,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子周桓王三年。晉翼侯自隨入于鄂，是謂鄂侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1055,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，晉曲沃莊伯卒，子稱繼，是謂武公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1057,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，宋、齊、衛之君盟于瓦屋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":1059,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，秦自汧、渭之間徙居郿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1061,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰，齊㑹魯、鄭之師伐宋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448589364330530"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1065,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳，魯亂，公子翬殺其君隱公，立惠公之子，是謂桓公，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1067,"lineType":1,"content":"翬為之輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1069,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1071,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未，宋亂，太宰華督殺司馬孔父及弑其君殤公，迎𥡆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1073,"lineType":1,"content":"公子馮于鄭而立之，是謂莊公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum" {"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1095,"lineType":1,"content":"是謂武王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1097,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448589364396066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1101,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1103,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰，鄭莊公卒，世子忽繼。宋執鄭祭仲，立突，是謂厲公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1105,"lineType":1,"content":"忽奔衛，祭仲專政。衛宣公殺其二子伋、壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1107,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳衛宣公卒，子朔立，是謂惠公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1109,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午，齊㑹宋、衛、燕伐魯，不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":1111,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未，秦三父殺出子而立世子，是謂武公。齊釐公卒，世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1113,"lineType":1,"content":"子諸兒繼，是謂襄公。宋㑹齊、蔡、陳伐鄭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1115,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申，周桓王崩，太子佗嗣立，是謂莊王。鄭祭仲殺雍紏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448589364379682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1119,"lineType":1,"content":"而逐厲公，迎忽反政，是謂昭公。秦伐彭戲氏于華","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1121,"lineType":1,"content":"山。齊襄公削公子無知禄。宋㑹魯、衛、陳伐鄭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1123,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉，衛公子伋壽傅逐惠公，立伋之弟黔牟，公出奔齊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1125,"lineType":1,"content":"宋㑹魯、衛、陳、蔡伐鄭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1127,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌，秦夷三父族。鄭高渠彌弑其君昭公，立其弟子亹，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":1129,"lineType":1,"content":"彌專政。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1131,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥，周有黑肩之難。齊襄公殺魯桓公于濼，立其子同，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"是謂莊公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"572","lineNum":1133,"lineType":1,"content":"又㑹諸侯于首止，殺鄭子亹。高渠彌逃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448590589050943"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":1137,"lineType":1,"content":"歸，與祭仲迎公子嬰于陳，立之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":1139,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子，周王姬下嫁于齊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":1141,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑，周葬桓王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":1143,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":1145,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯，周伐隨，責尊楚也。齊伐紀，紀侯大去其國。楚王卒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":1147,"lineType":1,"content":"于伐隨。子貲繼，是謂文王，始都郢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":1149,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰，齊㑹宋、魯、陳、蔡伐衛，入惠公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":1151,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳，衛惠公復入，殺二公子傅，黔牟奔周。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448584926855187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":1155,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之卯二千二百一十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":1157,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午周莊王十年。秦滅小虢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":1159,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未，齊公子無知以葵丘之戍人入，弑襄公代立。公子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":1161,"lineType":1,"content":"糾奔魯，小白奔莒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":1163,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申，齊人殺無知，公子小白入，是謂桓公。紏後入，不克。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"齊伐魯，殺紏，其傅召忽死之。管仲請囚，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":1165,"lineType":1,"content":"又相桓公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":1167,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉，魯敗齊師于長勺，敗宋師于乘丘。楚敗蔡師于莘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":1169,"lineType":1,"content":"以蔡侯獻舞歸。自是江漢之國皆服于楚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448585673293839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":1173,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":1175,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，周莊王崩，太子胡齊嗣位，是謂釐王。宋亂，南宫萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":1177,"lineType":1,"content":"弑其君湣公及其大夫仇牧。太宰華督立公子游。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":1179,"lineType":1,"content":"羣公子奔蕭，攻萬及殺游，立公弟御說，是謂桓公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":1181,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子，齊㑹宋、陳、蔡、邾之師伐魯，三敗之，取遂。又㑹魯于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":1183,"lineType":1,"content":"柯，遂復其侵地，曹沫刼盟故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":1185,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑，齊㑹陳、曹及王人伐宋。楚師入蔡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":1187,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅，齊桓公㑹宋、陳、衛、鄭之君，盟于鄄。晉曲沃武公滅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448590589067327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"翼，以重寳入周，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"603","lineNum":1191,"lineType":1,"content":"得請為諸侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":1193,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯，齊桓公㑹陳、宋、魯、衛、鄭、許、滑、滕之君，盟于幽。秦武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":1195,"lineType":1,"content":"公卒，弟徳公立。楚滅鄧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":1197,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰，周釐王崩，太子閔嗣位，是謂惠王。晉武公卒，子獻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":1199,"lineType":1,"content":"公詭諸繼。秦徙居雍。楚文王卒，世子艱繼，是謂杜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":1201,"lineType":1,"content":"敖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":1203,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳秦徳公卒，子宣公繼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":1205,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448589364412450"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":1209,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未，周有五大夫之難，邊伯、石速、蒍國以蔡、衛之師攻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":1211,"lineType":1,"content":"王，立弟頽，王出居鄭之櫟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":1213,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申，鄭厲公及虢叔入王于成周，殺頽而執仲父及五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":1215,"lineType":1,"content":"大夫，難遂平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":1217,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉，秦作密畤，敗晉師于河。晉伐驪，獲女以為姬。陳公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":1219,"lineType":1,"content":"子完奔齊。楚亂，弟惲殺其君囏代立，是謂成王。","logicSen 1,"content":"丙寅，齊桓公㑹陳、宋、魯、衛、鄭、許、曹之君及王世子，盟于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448589439811599"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"首止。𣈆伐蒲，重耳奔翟。又伐虞及虢，虢君奔周。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":1281,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":1283,"lineType":1,"content":"年，秦始得志于諸侯，百里奚、蹇叔為之輔。楚滅弦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":1285,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，齊伐鄭。𣈆伐屈，夷吾奔梁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":1287,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":1289,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳，周惠王崩，太子鄭嗣位，是謂襄王。太叔作難。齊師、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":1291,"lineType":1,"content":"宋、衛、許、曹、陳㑹王人于洮。𣈆伐翟，不利于齧桑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，齊桓公㑹宰孔、周公及宋、衛、鄭、許、曹之君于葵丘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":1295,"lineType":1,"content":"宋襄公立。𣈆獻公卒，公子奚齊立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1313,"lineType":1,"content":"而又伐之。楚滅英。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448585715351606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，齊桓公㑹宋、陳、魯、衛、鄭、許、曹之君，盟于牡丘，以救","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"徐。管仲卒，易牙專政。秦伐𣈆，敗之于韓原，獲其君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"夷吾。夷吾獻河西地，乃得還，仍以世子圉為質。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑戌，攻周。齊㑹諸侯師戍周，又㑹宋、魯、陳、鄭、許、邢、曹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"之君于淮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"以全鄫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅，齊桓公卒，五公子爭國，公子無詭立，易牙專政，世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"子昭出奔宋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":1331,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯，宋㑹曹、衛、邾伐齊，無詭子敗，四公子立世子昭，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448585673310223"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1335,"lineType":1,"content":"謂孝侯。狄伐衛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1337,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰，秦滅梁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1339,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1341,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午，宋襄公㑹楚、陳、蔡、鄭、許、曹六國之君于盂。楚成王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1343,"lineType":1,"content":"執宋襄公于㑹以伐宋，盟而釋之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1345,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未，齊入王叔帶于周。秦、𣈆徙陸渾之戎于伊川。宋㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1347,"lineType":1,"content":"衛、許、滕伐鄭，不利。𣈆公子圉自秦逃歸。楚救鄭，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":1349,"lineType":1,"content":"敗宋師于泓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448589439827983"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1353,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申，周頽叔、桃子以狄師伐鄭，遂以狄女隗氏為后。宋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1355,"lineType":1,"content":"襄公卒，子成公壬臣繼。齊伐宋。楚伐陳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":1357,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉，周襄王廢狄后，頽叔、桃子以狄師攻周，王出居鄭","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1359,"lineType":1,"content":"之汜。叔帶代立，與狄后居于温。𣈆有郤苪之難，惠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1361,"lineType":1,"content":"公卒，世子圉繼，是謂懷公。秦𥡆公使人殺之，而立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1363,"lineType":1,"content":"公子重耳，是謂文公。趙衰為原大夫，專政。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1365,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌，秦、𣈆之師滅王叔帶于温，而納王于成周。王享𣈆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":1367,"lineType":1,"content":"文公于郟，而命益之河內地。衛文公卒，世子成公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448586134749210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1371,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭繼。楚圍陳以入頓子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1373,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥，宋背楚親𣈆，楚滅蘷，伐宋，又伐齊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1375,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子，齊孝公卒，弟潘父殺世子代立，是謂昭公。𣈆救宋，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1377,"lineType":1,"content":"作三軍。楚使子玉伐宋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1379,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑，周襄王狩于河陽。𣈆㑹齊、宋、蔡、秦之師伐衛，大敗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1381,"lineType":1,"content":"楚師于城濮，遂㑹齊、宋、蔡、鄭、魯、衛之君，盟于踐土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1383,"lineType":1,"content":"楚救鄭，不利，殺令尹子玉得臣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":1385,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅，𣈆㑹王人及諸侯于翟泉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448586134765594"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1389,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯，衛成公自陳如周，周請𣈆納成公于衛，而誅大夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1391,"lineType":1,"content":"元咺及公子瑕。秦、𣈆圍鄭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":1393,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰，魯取濟西田，衛徙居帝丘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1395,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳，𣈆文公卒，世子歡繼，是謂襄公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1397,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之巳二千二百一十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1399,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午周襄王二十五年。秦𥡆公伐鄭。𣈆敗秦師于殽，獲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1401,"lineType":1,"content":"其帥孟明視、西乞術、白乙丙。魯僖公卒，世子興繼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1403,"lineType":1,"content":"是謂文公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448604979576870"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1407,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未，𣈆歸秦三帥。楚亂，世子商臣殺其君惲代立，是謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1409,"lineType":1,"content":"𥡆王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1411,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申，秦伐𣈆，不利于彭衙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1413,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉，秦伐𣈆，取王官。楚伐江，𣈆師來救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1415,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌，秦伐西戎，破國十二。楚滅江。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1417,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，𣈆趙成子衰卒，子盾繼事。楚滅六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1419,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子，秦𥡆公卒，世子罃繼，是謂康公。葬𥡆公，三良為殉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1421,"lineType":1,"content":"𣈆襄公卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448586134781978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1425,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑，𣈆世子夷臯繼，是謂靈公。宋成公卒，國亂，弟禦殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1427,"lineType":1,"content":"世代立，國人殺禦公，立子杵臼，是謂昭公。齊率宋、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1429,"lineType":1,"content":"衛、陳、鄭、許、曹之君，㑹趙盾于扈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1431,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅，周襄王崩，太子壬臣嗣位，是謂頃王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1433,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯，周葬襄王。𣈆㑹諸侯人救鄭。秦伐𣈆，取武遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1435,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰，𣈆伐秦，取少梁。秦伐𣈆，取比徵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1437,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳，魯敗狄于鹹，獲其帥喬如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1439,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午，秦伐𣈆，取羈馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448590589083711"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1443,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未，楚𥡆王卒，世子莒繼，是謂莊王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1445,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申，周頃王崩，國亂，公卿爭權，𣈆趙盾平周亂而立王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1447,"lineType":1,"content":"子班，是謂匡王。宋及諸侯盟于新城。齊昭公卒，國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1449,"lineType":1,"content":"亂，公子商人殺世子舍代立，是謂懿公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1451,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉，秦伐蔡。齊伐魯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1453,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌，齊脩郪丘之盟。宋人弑其君昭公，弟鮑立，是謂文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1455,"lineType":1,"content":"公。楚滅庸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1457,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥，𣈆㑹衛、陳、鄭伐宋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448604979593254"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1461,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子，魯文公卒于臺下。襄仲殺世子惡而立公子俀，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1463,"lineType":1,"content":"謂宣公。三桓專政。秦康公卒，世子稻繼，是謂共公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":1465,"lineType":1,"content":"齊亂，大夫丙歜弑其君懿公，立公子元，是謂惠公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":1467,"lineType":1,"content":"宋亂，羣公子作難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1469,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑，齊取魯濟西田。𣈆伐鄭。楚侵陳及宋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1471,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅，周匡王崩，弟瑜立，是謂定王。鄭敗宋師于大棘，獲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1473,"lineType":1,"content":"其太宰華元。晉伐鄭。秦伐晉。晉趙盾弑其君靈公，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1475,"lineType":1,"content":"迎襄公弟黑臀于周，立之，是謂成公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448604979626022"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1479,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯，周葬匡王。楚伐陸渾之戎，遂觀兵于周郊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":1481,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰，鄭亂，公子作難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳，晉伐陳以救鄭。秦共公卒，子繼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":1483,"lineType":1,"content":"是為桓公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":1485,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午，晉趙盾、衛孫免侵陳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":1487,"lineType":1,"content":"己未，晉㑹諸侯于黑壤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":1489,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申，晉伐秦。楚滅舒、蓼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":1491,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉，晉侯㑹宋、衛、陳、鄭于扈，陳不至，遂伐陳。𣈆成公卒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":1493,"lineType":1,"content":"于扈，公子據立，是謂景公。趙盾卒，子朔繼事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448592920985610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1497,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌，齊歸魯濟西田。齊惠公卒，子無野立，是謂頃公。大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1499,"lineType":1,"content":"夫崔杼奔衛。陳亂，夏徵舒弑其君靈公。𣈆伐鄭，楚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1501,"lineType":1,"content":"師來救。楚伐鄭，𣈆師來救。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1503,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，楚伐陳，誅夏徵舒，納公孫寧、儀行父于陳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1505,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之午二千二百一十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1507,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子周定王十年。楚伐鄭，大敗𣈆師于河上。𣈆屠岸賈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1509,"lineType":1,"content":"作難于下宫，殺趙朔及其族。朔妻匿于公宫，生武。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1511,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，楚伐宋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448585673342991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1515,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，楚圍宋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1517,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，周定王殺二伯。𣈆滅赤狄及潞氏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1519,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰，周宣王榭火。𣈆滅申氏。又平王室之亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1521,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳，𣈆㑹諸侯之君于斷道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1523,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，魯宣公卒，世子黑肱繼，是謂成公。𣈆伐齊。楚莊王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1525,"lineType":1,"content":"卒，世子審繼，是謂共王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":1527,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未，周伐茅戎，不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":1529,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申，齊伐魯、衛敗魯之師于新築。𣈆㑹諸侯之師救衛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448604979642406"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":1533,"lineType":1,"content":"大敗齊師于鞌。宋文公卒，子瑕繼，是謂共公。華元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":1535,"lineType":1,"content":"專國，兩盟于𣈆。楚㑹十國之人于蜀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":1537,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，𣈆㑹宋、衛、魯、曹伐鄭。鄭兩伐許。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":1539,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，𣈆伐楚救鄭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{ ,"lineType":1,"content":"封季札于延陵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1701,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅，衛亂，𡩋喜、孫林父爭權，林父不勝，奔𣈆，𡩋喜弑其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1703,"lineType":1,"content":"君剽。𣈆執𡩋喜，求衛侯于齊而納之，封林父于宿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1705,"lineType":1,"content":"齊慶封夷崔杼族而專國。鄭封子產六邑。楚㑹陳、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1707,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡伐鄭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":1709,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯，𣈆用趙武為正卿，是為文子，與韓宣子起、魏武子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448609219969035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"絳同執國命，㑹諸侯之大夫于宋。衛殺甯喜。晉、楚、齊、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"秦同㑹于宋，從向戌之請，將弭兵也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰，周靈王崩，太子貴嗣位，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

d":"253","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"取楚之淮北，西侵韓、趙、魏。魏獻秦安邑。秦伐魏之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"河內，攻韓之夏山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，齊孟嘗君以薛屬魏。秦昭襄王㑹楚頃襄王于宛，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹趙惠文王于中陽，伐齊。㧞九城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448598214328370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，燕樂毅㑹秦、楚、韓、魏五國之師伐齊，大敗齊師于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"濟西，遂入臨菑，㧞城七十。拜樂毅上卿，封昌國君。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"留圍齊卽墨及莒。齊湣王保莒。楚使淖齒救齊，殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"齊湣王于莒。莒人立其子法章，是謂襄王。荀卿行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"祭酒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅，楚頃襄王㑹秦昭襄王于鄢。秦穰侯伐衛，至于國。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯，秦昭襄王㑹韓釐王于新城，㑹魏昭王于新明，伐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"趙，㧞二城。伐韓，取六邑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448607924076570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content": Yin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"子楚立，是謂莊襄王。以華陽夫人為后，子政為太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"子，吕不韋為丞相，封文信侯，食河南十萬户。楚春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448617747005449"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"申君入弔于秦。燕將栗腹攻趙，不利。趙廉頗破燕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"軍于鄗，封信平侯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥，東周君㑹諸侯攻秦，不利，没于秦。秦丞相吕不韋","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"平東周，盡入其地，置三川郡，徙其君于陽人。趙廉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"頗伐燕，圍其國。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子，秦蒙驁㧞趙太原，㧞韓滎陽及成臯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑，秦蒙驁㧞魏高都，又舉趙三十城。楚、齊、魏、韓、燕、趙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"攻秦，不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448607924191258"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅，秦莊襄王卒，太子政繼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

"lineId":"379","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳，秦伐趙，一軍攻鄴，一軍攻狼孟。燕太子丹自秦逃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"歸。趙李牧扞秦有功。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，魏獻秦麗邑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未，秦內史勝滅韓，獲其王，以其地為潁川郡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申，秦王翦下井陘，大破趙軍，進圍鉅鹿。趙以趙葱代","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"李牧，顏聚代司馬尚將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448609266368547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，秦王翦滅趙，獲其王，以其地為趙郡。楚幽王卒，母","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"弟猶立，庶兄負芻殺猶代立。魏景湣王卒，子假繼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"趙亡，太子喜稱王于代。㑹燕軍于上谷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，秦王翦破燕軍于易水。燕荆軻使秦不還。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥，秦王翦、王賁滅燕，獲其太子丹。剪謝病還㧞楚城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，秦王賁滅魏，決河灌大梁，獲其王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，秦王翦破楚，殺其將項燕。楚䘮師于蘄，走壽春。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅，秦王翦、蒙武滅楚，獲其王，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"以其地為楚郡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448617746989065"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯，秦王賁平遼東，獲燕王；平代，獲趙太子。王翦定越，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"以其地為㑹稽郡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰，秦王翦滅齊，獲其王，以其地為齊郡。東至海及朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"鮮，西至臨洮、羌中，南至北嚮户，北至隂山、遼東。分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"天下地為三十六郡，罷侯置守。鑄天下兵為十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"金人。徙天下豪富十二萬户于咸陽。大建宮室，作","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"阿房，為萬世業，稱始皇帝。更以建亥月為歲首。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳，西廵狩，至于隴右、北地，及回中，乃復。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448609266335779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午，東廵狩，至于鄒嶧，封太山，禪梁甫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"南登琅邪。丞相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"隗林、王綰，卿士李斯、王戊，五大夫趙嬰，將軍楊樛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"及九侯，勒帝功于金石，表于海上。遂南至于衡山，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"浮江，自南郡由武關，乃復。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未，東廵狩，至博浪沙中，遇盜，遂登之罘，刻石紀功。北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"由上黨，乃復。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620590759988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌，北廵狩，至于碣石，由上郡，乃復。使蒙恬擊胡，取河","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"南地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"南取陸梁地，為桂林、象郡。又北斥匃奴，自榆中並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"河以東，屬之隂山，為三十四縣，城河上為塞。又使","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"蒙恬渡河取高闕、陶山、北假中，築亭障。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子，置酒咸陽宮，聚天下書焚之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑，聚天下學士于驪山，坑之。廣阿房宫，自咸陽達于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"渭南。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620309790731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯，南廵狩，至于雲夢。左丞相馮去疾留守，右丞相李","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"斯從行。少子胡亥請行，至九疑，浮江，東至于㑹稽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"又北至于琅邪，由平原達沙丘，崩。左丞相李斯、宦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"氏趙高假帝書，更立少子胡亥。賜上郡太子將軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"蒙恬死。遂還咸陽。胡亥立，是謂二世皇帝。葬始皇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"帝驪山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰，宦氏趙高為中郎令，專政。東廵狩，至于㑹稽北，又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448607924207642"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"至于遼東，乃復大殺王族及羣臣。復廣阿房，徵天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"下材士，以五萬人為屯，衛咸陽三百里，不得食其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"穀。戌卒陳勝稱王于楚，關東郡邑皆殺其令長以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"應陳勝而西攻秦。陳勝將武臣稱王于趙，魏咎稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"王于魏，狄人田儋稱王于齊，楚人項梁兵㑹稽，徐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"人劉季稱兵豐沛。陳勝兵西攻秦，至于戲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳，秦殺右丞相馮去疾、將軍馮刼及囚左丞相李斯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"諫罷阿房故也。將軍章邯滅陳勝于城父，破項梁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448616471969803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"于定陶，平田儋于臨濟，渡河北攻趙。田儋死，其弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"榮立儋子市為王。陳勝將秦嘉立勝子景駒為王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"項梁殺景駒，求楚懷王孫心立之，保旴台。項梁死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"其子羽軍彭城，其將劉季軍碭山。楚王心收項梁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"軍，自旴台徙彭城。以劉季為碭郡長，封武安侯，俾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"南略地而西攻秦。以項羽為魯國公，封長安侯，俾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"北救趙而西攻秦。約先入關者王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之未二千二百二十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448614102351909"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午秦二世三年，中郎令趙高稱丞相，殺李斯及弑其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"君胡亥于望夷宮。代立不克，立二世兄之子嬰為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"王。嬰立，夷趙高三族。沛公兵十萬由武關入至咸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，秦子嬰降于軹道。收圖籍，封宮室府庫，示衆人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"以約法三章，還軍灞上，以待東諸侯。項羽北救趙，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"殺大將軍宋義。至鉅鹿，大敗章邯軍于洹水，秦軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"降者二十萬，悉坑之于新安。合齊趙魏韓燕五國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"之兵四十萬，由函谷而入，㑹沛公于戲，而屠咸陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620309905419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"殺子嬰，收子女玉帛，焚宫室府庫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未，項羽渝約，自主封建。立楚王心為義帝，徙之江南，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"都郴。封沛公季為漢王，遷之漢中，都南鄭。分秦關","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"中為三：一封降將張邯為雍王，都廢邱；一封降將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"司馬欣為塞王，都櫟陽；一封降將董翳為翟王，都","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"高奴。分齊為三：一封齊將田都為臨菑王，都臨菑；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"一封齊將田安為濟北王，都博陽；一封齊王田市","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"為膠東王，都卽墨。分楚為三：一封楚將英布為九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620590776372"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"江王，都六；一封楚將共敖為臨江王，都江陵；一封","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"番君呉芮為衡山王，都邾。分趙為二：一封楚將張","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"耳為常山王，都襄國；一封趙王歇為代王，都鴈門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"分韓為二：一封楚將申陽為河南王，都洛陽；一封韓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"成為韓王，都陽翟。分魏為二：一封趙將司馬卬為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"殷王，都朝歌；一封魏王豹為魏王，都平陽。分燕為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"二：一封燕將臧茶為燕王，都薊；一封燕王韓廣為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"遼東王，都無終。封呉芮將梅鋗十萬户侯，趙歇將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448609266352163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"陳餘環三縣，田市將田榮不及封。羽自稱西楚伯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"王，王梁地九郡，都彭城。諸王之在戲下者，咸遣罷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"兵就國。羽亦東出，使人殺義帝于江上，殺韓王成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"以鄭昌代之。臧茶殺韓廣于燕，幷有其地。田榮殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"田都、田安、田市于齊，幷有其地，稱齊王。彭越受榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"符以覆梁地，陳餘受榮兵以破常山。趙王歇自代","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"遷都鉅鹿，張耳走漢。項羽北破田榮于齊。榮死，弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"橫立，榮子廣復保城陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620309889035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申，漢王自南鄭東收三秦、二韓、五侯兵，合三河士五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"十六萬，東伐楚，入彭城，取重寳、美女，為置酒高㑹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"項羽至自伐齊，大敗漢軍于睢水，殺十餘萬，幷獲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"漢王父母、妻子。漢王退保滎陽，築甬道以通敖倉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"粟，使將韓信、張耳攻魏、趙。丞相蕭何兵至自關中，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"自此日戰于京、索間。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉，楚圍漢于滎陽，㧞之，紀信、周苛、樅公死之。漢退師","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":972,"lineType":1,"content":"保成臯。九江王英布降于漢。彭越破楚軍于下邳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620590825524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"韓信、張耳平魏、趙，還軍脩武。漢王自成臯北渡河","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"至脩武，使張耳收兵越地。韓信伐齊，盧綰、劉賈南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"渡白馬津，㑹彭越攻楚，楚又㧞漢成臯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌，漢復取成臯，與楚對兵廣武。韓信平齊，乞封假王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"項羽請和，約分天下于鴻溝，歸漢王父母妻子。還","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"軍至陽夏，漢軍復至，楚復敗漢軍。漢又大㑹韓信、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"彭越、英布及諸侯兵于垓下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，漢滅楚。項羽死于東城，漢王以魯國公禮葬羽于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620590809140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"穀城。楚之諸侯而王者，並降封侯。封齊王韓信為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"楚王，治下邳；建成侯彭越為梁王，治定陶；九江王英","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"布為淮南王，治廣陵；韓王信為韓王，治陽翟；衡山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":1000,"lineType":1,"content":"王呉苪為長沙王，治臨湘。肇帝位于汜水之陽，西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"都長安，大建宮室。燕王臧茶不恭命，攻下代郡，往","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"平之，獲臧茶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"以太尉盧綰為燕王。齊王田廣卒，叔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"橫立，入于海。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1008,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子，帝游雲夢，㑹諸侯于陳。執楚王韓信歸，降為淮隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620309856267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"侯。分其地為二：一封劉賈為荆王，治淮東；一封弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"交為楚王，治淮西。別封子肥為齊王。徙韓王信為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"太原王。匈奴㓂馬邑，韓王信以衆叛。帝尊父太公","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"為太上皇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑，帝北征韓王信于銅鞮，信走匃奴，遂及匃奴至于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"平城。匃奴圍帝于平城七日。樊噲北定代，以兄仲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"為代王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":1026,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅，建未央宮。代王劉仲自雁門逃歸，廢為合陽侯。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448605483089939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"陳豨為代王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯，大朝諸侯于未央宮。趙相貫高事覺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":1034,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰，太上皇及太上后崩。陳豨以雁門叛。帝北征，誅淮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"隂侯韓信，并夷三族。以蕭何為相國。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳，梁王彭越以定陶叛，平之，夷三族。淮南王英布以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"廣陵叛，兼有淮東、西地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午，帝征淮南，平之，夷英布三族。周勃平代，獲陳豨于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":1044,"lineType":1,"content":"當城。帝崩，太子盈踐位，是謂惠帝。太后呂氏臨朝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448605483122707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":1048,"lineType":1,"content":"稱制，蕭何、曹參、陳平、周勃輔政。葬高祖于長陵。盧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":1050,"lineType":1,"content":"綰以燕叛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未，太后殺趙王如意及其母夫人戚氏。齊王肥獻陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"城為魯元公主湯沐邑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申，相國蕭何卒，曹參為相國。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉，城長安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌，除挾書律。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":1062,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥，相國曹參卒，王陵為右丞相，陳平為左丞相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620590874676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":1066,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子，太尉樊噲卒，周勃為太尉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":1068,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑，惠帝崩，立無名子為帝。葬惠帝于安陵。封呂氏四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":1070,"lineType":1,"content":"人為王，六人為侯。罷王陵相，進陳平右丞相，以審","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":1072,"lineType":1,"content":"食其為左丞相。關政于內，太后專制。名雉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":1074,"lineType":1,"content":"申寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":1076,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":1078,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":1080,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳，幽無名子于永巷，殺之。立恒山王義為帝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448618728472615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":1084,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午，尉它稱帝南越。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":1086,"lineType":1,"content":"己未，匈奴㓂狄道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":1088,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申，太后殺趙王友。以梁王呂產為相國，趙王呂禄為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":1090,"lineType":1,"content":"上將軍，分綂南北軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":1092,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉，太后呂氏崩。丞相陳平、太尉周勃、朱虛侯劉章、曲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":1094,"lineType":1,"content":"周侯酈商及子寄誅呂禄、呂產，獲南北軍，夷呂氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":1096,"lineType":1,"content":"三族。廢恒山王義，迎高祖中子代王恒于鴈門，立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":1098,"lineType":1,"content":"之，是謂文帝。以宋昌為衛將軍，專南北軍。丞相陳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448608930824244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":1102,"lineType":1,"content":"平讓周勃右丞相而為左丞相，灌嬰為太尉，張武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":1104,"lineType":1,"content":"為中郎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":1106,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌，以皇子啟為皇太子。周勃免相，陳平兼左右丞相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":1108,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，丞相陳平卒。周勃復相。始作銅虎符。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":1110,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之申二千二百二十九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":1112,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，漢孝文皇帝三年。免周勃相，以灌嬰為相。王興居","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":1114,"lineType":1,"content":"以濟北叛，平之。匃奴㓂北地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":1116,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，絳侯周勃下廷尉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448616472035339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":1120,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":1122,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

tenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":2536,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰，晉賈充以女上太子妃，遂為司空。呉攺元鳳凰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":2538,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳，晉何曾為司徒。呉師寇晉弋陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619017860539154468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":2542,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之亥二千二百四十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":2544,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午，晉武帝十年呉王皓十年，晉分幽州，城平州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":2546,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未，晉改元咸寧，呉改元天璽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":2548,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申，晉東西夷十七國內附。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":2550,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉，晉四夷內附。呉攺元天紀。將邵凱、夏祥逃入于晉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":2552,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌，呉將劉翻、祖始逃入于晉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":2554,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，晉命賈充督楊渾、瑯琊王伸、王戎、胡奮、杜預、唐彬、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":2556,"lineType":1,"content":"王𤀹七將兵二十萬伐呉。是年，汲人發魏襄王塜，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619017860539170852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":2560,"lineType":1,"content":"得書七十五卷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":2562,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子，晉平呉，徙孫皓于洛陽，攺元太康。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":2564,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":2566,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":2566,"lineType":1,"content":"東西夷二十九國脩貢。山濤為司徒，衛瓘為司空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":2568,"lineType":1,"content":"賈充卒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":2570,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯，孫皓卒。魏舒為司徒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":2572,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":2574,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619017860539187236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":2578,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":2580,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":2582,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":2584,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉，汝南王亮為司馬，假黃鉞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":2586,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌，攺元太熙。武帝崩，太子衷踐位，是謂惠帝，冊妃賈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":2588,"lineType":1,"content":"氏為皇后，攺元永熙。葬武帝于峻陵。王渾為司徒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":2590,"lineType":1,"content":"何邵為太師，裴楷為少師，和嶠為少保，王戌為少","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":2592,"lineType":1,"content":"傅，衛瓘為太保，石鑒為司空。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619017860539203620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":2596,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥，改元元康。皇后賈氏專制，夷十二大臣族，太傅楊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":2598,"lineType":1,"content":"駿、太保衛瓘、汝南王亮皆被戮焉。廢太后楊氏為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":2600,"lineType":1,"content":"庶人，徙之金墉，遣諸王就國，攺元元康。趙王倫為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":2602,"lineType":1,"content":"征西將軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":2604,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子，賈后弑皇太后楊氏于金墉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":2606,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":2608,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":2610,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯，武庫火。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619017860539220004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":2614,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰，張華為司空。秦雍寇亂，齊萬年稱兵涇陽，楊茂搜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":2616,"lineType":1,"content":"稱兵百頃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":2618,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳，王戎為司徒，何劭為僕射。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":2620,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":2622,"lineType":1,"content":"己未，賈后廢皇太子遹為庶人，及其二子送之金墉。裴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":2624,"lineType":1,"content":"頠為僕射。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":2626,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申，攺元永康。皇后賈氏徙皇庶人于許昌，殺之。趙王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":2628,"lineType":1,"content":"倫、梁王彤廢皇后賈氏為庶人，送金墉殺之。誅宰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619017860539236388"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":2632,"lineType":1,"content":"相張華及僕射裴頠、侍中賈謐，又誅嵇康、呂安、石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":2634,"lineType":1,"content":"崇、潘岳于東市。倫假黃鉞，稱國相，專制，以彤為太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":2636,"lineType":1,"content":"宰，冊羊氏為皇后。賈氏黨趙廞以成都叛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":2638,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉，趙王倫竊命，徙帝于金墉，攺元建始。齊王冏、成都","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":2640,"lineType":1,"content":"王穎、河間王顒兵入，誅趙王倫及其黨，迎帝反正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":2642,"lineType":1,"content":"冏大司馬，專制，以穎為大將軍，顒為太尉，改元永","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":2644,"lineType":1,"content":"寧。流人李特殺趙廞于成都，張軌以梁州叛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":2647,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌，長沙王乂、河間王顒、成都王穎、新野王歆、范陽王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619017860539252772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":2651,"lineType":1,"content":"虓兵入誅齊王冏，送其族于金墉，殺之。乂稱太尉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":2653,"lineType":1,"content":"專制，改元太安。流人李特以六郡稱兵廣漢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":2655,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，河間王顒、成都王穎、東海王越執長沙王乂，送之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":2657,"lineType":1,"content":"金墉，殺之。顒稱太宰，專制于長安。陸機、陸雲兵死，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":2659,"lineType":1,"content":"石冰以楊徐亂。李特攻成都不克，死，子雄繼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":2661,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極經世書卷六上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
