{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"經元之甲，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"經㑹之午，七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"經運之辛，一百八十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之子二千二百四十五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，晉惠帝十四年河間王顒廢皇后羊氏及皇太子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448639293227059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"覃，徙之金墉。表成都王穎為太弟，加九錫，鎮鄴，改","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"元永安。右衛將軍陳眕復羊氏皇后及覃太子，大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹司徒王戎及東海王越、高密王簡、平昌公模、呉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"王晏、豫章王熾、襄陽王範、左僕射荀藩八部兵奉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"帝北伐鄴師敗于湯隂，嵆紹死之。帝如北軍，穎以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"帝歸鄴，攺元建武。顒將張方入洛，復廢皇后羊氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"及覃太子。安北將軍王浚、東瀛公騰以烏丸兵攻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"鄴，穎師敗，帝還洛陽。河間王使張方徙帝西都長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924062739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"安，亦復羊氏皇后及永安年號，廢穎太弟，以豫章","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"王熾為太弟，攺元永興。王戎豫朝政，始分東西臺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"是年，李雄逐羅尚于成都，稱王單于。左賢王劉淵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"稱王離石，國曰漢，元曰元熙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，東海王越嚴兵徐方，范陽王虓抗師許昌，成都王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"潁擁兵河間北，河間王顒又復廢羊氏皇后，以穎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"為大將軍，都督河北。虓、越將周權入洛，又復羊氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"皇后。洛陽令何喬殺周權，又廢羊氏皇后。虓、越兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924029971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"攻潁不已，穎敗，棄鄴走洛陽。虓、越攻洛陽，穎奔顒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"于長安。漢劉淵攻晉劉琨于板橋，不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，東海王越、范陽王虓兵攻長安，河間王顒、成都王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"穎走南山。虓、越將祁𢎞、宋胄以帝東還洛陽，復以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"羊氏為皇后，攺元光熈。越稱太傅、録尚書事，專制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"虓為司空，卒。越遂弑帝，立太弟熾，是謂懷帝。引温","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"羡為司徒，王衍為司空。顒、穎野死。李雄稱帝成都，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"國曰蜀，元曰太武，謂之後蜀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624000811045"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，晉攺元永嘉。東海王越稱大丞相，鎮許昌，以后父","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"梁芬為太尉。成都王黨汲桑陷鄴。王彌稱兵青、徐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"漢劉淵破晉河東諸郡。晉劉琨獨保晉陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰，劉淵稱帝蒲子，改元永鳳，㧞晉平陽居之。王彌、石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"勒附于漢。石勒攻常山。王彌攻洛陽，焚建春門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳，東海王越入洛，殺大臣十餘人，以左僕射山簡征","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"東大將軍、都督荆州，南鎮襄陽。漢劉淵改元河瑞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"石勒兵出鉅鹿，王彌兵出上黨，劉聰兵出壺關，同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924177427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"攻晉洛陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，東海王越徵兵天下，諸侯咸無從者，自率兵出許","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"昌。漢劉淵卒，子和繼。叔楚王聰殺和代立，改元光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"興。以北海王義為皇太弟，劉曜為相國，石勒為大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"將軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未，天下亂，晉詔兖州茍晞㑹諸侯兵伐許昌，㑹東海","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"王越卒，乃止。是年，洛陽陷，王衍為軍帥，王師十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"敗，帝及傳國六璽皆沒于寇。長安亦陷，南陽王模","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924128275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"亦没于寇。漢劉曜、王彌、石勒㧞晉洛陽，俘其帝于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"平陽。攺元嘉平。劉曜㧞晉長安，保之。石勒害王彌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"于己吾，而幷其衆。蜀李雄㧞晉梓潼及涪城。攺元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"玉衡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申，晉懷帝在平陽，賈疋逐劉曜于長安三輔，與閻鼎、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"梁芬、梁綜、麴允共奉秦王鄴為皇太子，以入長安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"鎮東將軍瑯琊王𥈠帥亡衆大集壽春。茍晞保蒙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"城，不利，降于石勒。劉琨保晉陽，不利，奔常山。拓䟦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620339167232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"猗盧以兵六萬來救，大敗劉曜、劉粲于狼猛，劉琨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"復保陽曲。漢劉聰納劉殷女二人為皇后，孫四人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"為貴妃，㧞晉太原，復失之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，晉懷帝死于平陽，皇太子鄴稱帝長安，是謂愍帝，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"攺元建興。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"以梁芬為司徒，麴允為使持節、領軍、録","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"尚書事，索綝為尚書左僕射，瑯琊王𥈠為左丞相、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"都督陜東諸軍事，南陽王保為右丞相、都督陜西","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"諸軍事。山東郡縣悉陷于寇。漢石勒鎮襄國。曹嶷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620339216384"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"攻下三齊，據有廣固。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，晉以瑯琊王𥈠為大司馬，荀組為司空，劉琨為大","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"將軍，封凉州，張軌為太尉、西平郡王。軌卒，子寔繼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"稱西河王，國曰凉，元曰永興，城姑臧，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"80","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"是謂前凉。漢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"劉聰立三皇后，攺元建元。劉曜圍晉長安，石勒圍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"晉幽州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥，晉進左丞相、瑯琊王𥈠都督中外諸軍事，右丞相、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"南陽王保為相國，司空荀組為太尉、大將軍，劉琨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624684548105"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"為司空。陶侃平江表，獲杜弢。漢劉聰立七皇后，授","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"石勒專命，俾征伐。晉勒㧞晉濮陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，晉長安陷于寇，帝出降于豆田中。漢劉曜㧞晉長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"安，俘其帝于平陽，攺元麟嘉。石勒㧞晉太原。劉琨","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"走幽州，依段匹磾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，晉帝在平陽，瑯琊王𥈠渡江，稱晉王于建康，元曰建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"武。以西陽王業為太尉，王敦為大將軍，王導都督","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"中外。帝死于平陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924111891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅，晉王𥈠稱帝于建康，改元太興，以子紹為太子，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"謂東晉元帝。劉琨為段匹磾所害。王敦稱牧荆州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"王導𨳩府建康。漢劉聰卒，子粲繼，攺元漢昌。將靳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"凖殺粲代立。相國劉曜自長安入至赤壁稱帝，改","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"元光初，加大將軍勒九錫，封趙國公。國人誅勒、準","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"以迎曜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯，晉南陽王保保祁山，稱晉王。漢劉曜還長安，攺國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"曰趙，是謂前趙。殺石勒使者王循。石勒稱王襄國，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924161043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"國曰趙，元曰趙，是謂後趙。以張賓為之相，號大執","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"法；以弟虎為之將，號元輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰，晉南陽王保走桑城死。涼亂，殺張寔，寔弟茂代領","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"其衆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳，晉王導為司空、録尚書事。幽州陷，段匹磾没于石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lin ":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"都。涼張重華敗石虎于枹罕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448618292346915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申，晉桓温為征西大將軍，入長安，至于灞上。遼東慕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"容皝卒，子雋繼。趙石虎攻晉竟陵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉，晉平蜀亂。鮮卑慕容雋稱王遼東，國曰燕。元曰燕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"元，是謂前燕。趙石虎稱帝，攺元太寧。虎卒，子世繼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"張豺為相，專制。內難作，石遵自關右入，殺世及張","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"豺代立。石冰自薊門入，殺遵不克。石閔殺遵，立石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"鑒，攺元青龍。閔稱大將軍，專政。苻洪稱兵廣川。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌，趙石鑒殺大將軍閔及李農，不克，閔殺鑒代立，復","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620339183616"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"姓冉氏，攺國曰魏，元曰永興，大滅石氏宗室。鑒弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"祗稱帝襄國，以將劉顯南攻冉氏，不克，殺祗以降。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"閔破襄國，誅顯，滅其族。將苻健自枋頭入關，逐杜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"洪于長安，據之。將魏統以兖州、冉遇以豫州、樂引","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"以荆州、鄭系以洛州，入于晉。劉淮以幽州，入于燕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"燕南略地至幽、冀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"辛亥，趙將周成以廪丘，高昌以野王，樂立以許昌，李歴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"以衛州，請附于晉。劉啟、姚弋仲亦奔于晉。魏冉閔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624684531721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"攻燕不利，死，國亡。石虎將苻健稱天王于長安，國","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"曰秦，元曰皇始，是謂前秦。敗晉軍于五丈原。燕慕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"容雋南伐魏，滅冉閔于昌城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子，晉武陵王晞為太宰，㑹𥟵王昱為司徒，大將軍桓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"温為太尉。魏冉智以鄴降。燕慕容雋稱帝，自和龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"徙居中山，攺元元璽。秦苻健稱帝長安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑，涼、秦相攻。涼張重華卒，子曜靈繼，伯父祚殺曜靈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"代立，攺元和平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448620591038516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅，晉太尉桓温伐秦，至灞上，秦苻健敗晉軍于白鹿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"原，又敗之于子午谷。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"乙卯，晉將段龕敗燕軍于狼山，右軍王羲之辭官歸。涼","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"宋混、張瓘殺張祚，立曜靈弟元靚，改元大始。燕南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"攻晉不利。秦苻健卒，子生繼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰，晉桓温敗姚襄軍于伊水，遂復洛陽。秦苻生改元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"壽元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳，晉攺元升平，帝加元服，王彪之為左僕射。燕改元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624000794661"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"光壽，自中山徙都鄴。秦苻生虐用其人，雄子堅殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"生代立，去帝號，稱天王，改元永興，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"以王猛、呂婆樓、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"強汪、梁平老為之輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午，晉將馮鴦以衆入于燕，燕㧞晉上黨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"己未，晉伐燕不利，燕敗晉于東阿。秦攺元甘露，以王猛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"為中書令，尹京兆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申，晉仇池公楊駿卒，子世繼。燕慕容雋卒，子暐繼，攺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"元建熙。慕容恪為太宰專政。慕容評為太傅，慕容","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448624684515337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"根為太師，慕容𡸁為河南大都督。根作逆，伏誅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉，晉𥡆帝終，立成帝子瑯琊王丕，是謂哀帝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌，晉攺元隆和。燕師攻晉洛陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，晉攺元興寧。桓温為大司馬，假黃鉞，都督中外軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"事，北伐。涼張天錫殺元靚代立，攺元太清。燕將慕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"容評攻晉許昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之寅二千二百四十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，東晉哀帝三年。餌丹有疾，太后稱制。燕、秦入㓂洛","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448643948838966"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑， 王繹平侯景，使將朱買臣殺棟，稱帝江陵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"是謂元帝，攺元承聖。以陳霸先為征北大將軍，王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"僧辯為揚州刺史。武陵王紀稱帝成都，年用天正，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448643948970038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1390,"lineType":1,"content":"西魏稱元年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，梁平武陵王于蜀。西魏宇文泰殺尚書元烈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，梁蕭察引西魏兵陷江陵，殺繹及諸王。大將軍陳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"霸先、揚州刺史王僧辯立繹之子晉安王方智于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"潯陽，是謂恭帝，還都建業。王僧辯為太尉，居內；陳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1400,"lineType":1,"content":"霸先為司空，鎮丹徒。西魏宇文泰弑其君欽，立齊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1402,"lineType":1,"content":"王廓，攺元元年。泰用蕭察南征，㧞江陵，殺繹，徙其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"民于長安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448639293440051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥，梁貞陽侯蕭明自齊入，至東關，太尉王僧辯拒之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"不勝，遂迎蕭明入建業，立之，降方智為太子，改元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"天成。司徒陳霸先自丹徒入，殺王僧辯，廢蕭明為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"司徒，封建安公，復立方智，攺元紹泰。霸先為尚書，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"都督中外，專制。是年，蕭𧦴稱帝江陵，攺元大定，北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"附于宇文氏，是謂後南梁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，梁改元太平。陳霸先稱相國，敗齊軍于江上。西魏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"宇文泰卒，子覺繼事。是年，覺代西魏命于長安，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448661162246144"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"謂閔帝，改國為周，是謂後周，元稱元年，降其君廓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"為宋國公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，相國陳霸先進爵為陳王。十月，陳霸先代梁命于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"建業，是謂武帝，攺國為陳，元曰永定，降其君方智","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"為江隂王。周亂，宇文䕶殺其君覺，立宇文毓，是謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"明帝，稱元年。䕶為太宰，專制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅，梁蕭莊以郢州稱帝，救援于齊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"巳卯，陳武帝霸先殂，兄臨川王蒨立，是謂文帝，以子伯宗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448638924324883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"為太子。周宇文毓稱天王，攺元武成。齊宣王洋卒，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"子殷繼于晉陽，以諸父演為太師，湛為司馬。元氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"宗室無少長皆殺之，投于漳水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰，陳攺元天嘉。周亂，宇文䕶弑其君毓，立其弟邕，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1618,"lineType":1,"content":"以洛州為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"豫州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448646851330083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，改元大業。冊妃蕭氏為皇后，子晉王昭為皇太子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"以宇文述為左衛大將軍，郭衍為左武衛大將軍，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"于仲文為右武衛大將軍。尚書令楊素為太子太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"師，安徳王雄為太子太傅，河間王宏為太子太保。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"遵河由汴渚達于淮，謂之通濟渠。幸東都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1634,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，幸江都，還次東都。太子昭卒。封孫侗為越王，侑為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1636,"lineType":1,"content":"代王，浩為秦王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1638,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，還長安。北廵榆林。作宮于晉陽。光禄賀若弼、禮部","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448618292543523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1642,"lineType":1,"content":"郎宇文弼、太常卿高熲伏誅。西北大築亭障。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1644,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰，北廵五原。作宮于汾陽。遵河由清水達于海，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1646,"lineType":1,"content":"永濟渠。引沁水南達于河，北通涿郡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1648,"lineType":1,"content":"巳巳，西幸河右，征吐谷渾，至于覆袁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1650,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午，南幸江都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1652,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未，北幸涿郡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1654,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申，以兵百一十三萬三千八百為二十四軍，分左右","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1656,"lineType":1,"content":"道，大伐遼東，不利，全陷九軍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448659388039179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1660,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，以代王侑留守長安，越王侗留守東都，秦王浩從","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"駕征遼東。復大集兵于涿郡。天下羣盜起。楊𤣥感","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"以本兵叛于黎陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，高麗請降，乃班師。扶風盜稱帝，延安寇稱王，離石","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"賊稱天子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥，北廵。至于雁門，為突厥所圍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，南達江都。羣盜李密稱兵河南，竇建徳稱兵河北，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"林士𢎞稱兵江南，徐圓朗稱兵東山，劉武周稱兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448645261705225"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1678,"lineType":1,"content":"代北，薛舉稱兵隴右。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，煬帝在江都，唐公李淵自晉陽入，立代王侑于長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"安，以江都帝為太上皇，攺元義寧，淵稱唐王，專制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"羣盜竇建徳稱王河北。李密進據興洛，稱公，國曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"魏，元曰永平。薛舉稱帝隴右，國曰秦，元曰秦興。梁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1688,"lineType":1,"content":"師都稱兵夏州，李軌稱兵涼州，蕭銑稱兵巴陵，李","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"子通稱兵海陵，朱粲稱兵寇車，沈法興稱兵毗陵，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1692,"lineType":1,"content":"杜伏威稱兵厯陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448643949002806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅五月，唐王李淵代隋命于長安，是謂神堯皇帝，改","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":1698,"lineType":1,"content":"國曰唐，元曰武徳。以裴寂、劉文静為輔相，世子建","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"成為皇太子，次子世民為秦王，降其君為酅國公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"是年，宇文化及弑煬帝于江都，立秦王浩為主，化","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId 杜審權、杜悰為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"相。攺元咸通。宣、洪寇亂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳，相蕭鄴出尹太原。蔣伸罷相。林邑蠻入寇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448646507413538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午，徐州軍亂。林邑蠻陷交趾及安南都䕶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未，楊收、曹確高　為相。蠻陷安南州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申，杜審權出刺潤州。蕭寘為相。蠻㓂邕管。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉，徐商為相。高騈平林邑蠻，復安南都䕶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌，夏侯孜出尹成都。路巖為相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":931,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥，楊收觀察浙西。于琮為相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子，湘潭戍軍亂，立龎勛為帥，陷徐、宿、滁、和、濠五州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"貶楊收端州司馬，移驩州，賜死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448659388334091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑，蔣伸罷相。劉瞻為相。徐商出尹江陵。命十八將伐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"徐，以康成訓為軍帥。徐寇平，蠻復寇東西二川。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅，相曹確病免。韋保衡為相，大黜官吏。王鐸為相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯，相路巖出尹成都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"壬辰，劉鄴出刺幽州。于琮出刺襄州。趙隱為相，大行黜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":949,"lineType":1,"content":"陟。命沙陀李國昌移鎮雲中，國昌以大同阻命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":951,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳，征李國昌。蕭仿為相。冊普王儼為皇太子。韋保衡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":953,"lineType":1,"content":"行冡宰。帝崩，皇太子儼踐位，是謂恭定皇帝。兩軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448646507446306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":957,"lineType":1,"content":"中尉居中用事，黜冡宰韋保衡仍賜死，復前之官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":959,"lineType":1,"content":"吏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":961,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之未二千二百六十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":963,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午，唐恭定皇帝元年。葬懿宗于簡陵。崔彦昭、鄭畋、盧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":965,"lineType":1,"content":"攜為相。改元乾符。蠻寇兩川。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":967,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未，浙西及曹、濮㓂亂。王鐸復相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申，相蕭傚病免。浙西寇平。曹、濮王仙芝陷江淮南北","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":972,"lineType":1,"content":"十五州，至江南乞符節于朝，不聽。李蔚為相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448670557470756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉，冤句𡨥。黃巢陷沂、鄆，南㑹王仙芝將尚讓于蔡文","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"查牙山，破隨及江陵。沙陀李國昌寇朔州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌，江陵寇平。黃巢擾淮北、淮南及江南、廣南。李國昌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"陷岢嵐。昭義軍亂。鄭從讜為相。李蔚出守東都。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，黃巢據嶺表，乞符節于朝，不聽。罷盧攜、鄭畋相。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"崔沆、豆盧瑑為相。盧攜復相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子，攺元廣明。鄭從讜出尹太原。沙陀軍敗北。黃巢軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":990,"lineType":1,"content":"北逾五嶺，破湖湘及江淮、揚州。高騈距文不利，發","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448667705442341"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"徐、冤、許軍赴殷水以捍東都，殷水軍潰。黃巢陷東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"都，西攻郟，號潼關失守。罷盧攜相，王徽、裴徹為相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"黃巢陷長安，稱帝，國曰齊，元曰金統。帝出南山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":1000,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑，帝移軍興元。蕭遘為相，鄭畋為都統，楊復光為監","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"軍。羽書飛天下，沙陀順命請勤王。黃巢攻鳳翔，帝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"移幸成都，改元中和，以韋昭度為相。河中王重榮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"軍屯沙苑，涇原唐𢎞失軍屯渭北，易定王處存軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":1008,"lineType":1,"content":"屯渭橋，鄜延托䟦思恭軍屯武功，鳳翔鄭畋軍屯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448670909939752"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"盩厔，邠寧朱玫軍屯興平，荆裘王鐸軍至自行在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"王徽都督潞州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅，帝在成都。黃巢保長安，其將朱温以同州降，錫名","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"全忠。沙陀李克用自代北至，軍屯梁田。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯，帝在成都。諸將合攻，大破巢軍于渭南，巢走藍關，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":1022,"lineType":1,"content":"遂收京城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":1302,"lineType":1,"content":"以華州為興德府。韓建進封潁川王。汴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":1304,"lineType":1,"content":"將葛從周㧞李克用之邢、洺、磁，氏叔琮㧞趙匡凝","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":1306,"lineType":1,"content":"之隨、唐、鄧、澤州，李罕之㧞克用之上黨，歸于汴。幽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":1308,"lineType":1,"content":"州劉守文㧞汴之滄州。魏博羅𢎞信卒，子紹威稱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":1310,"lineType":1,"content":"留後。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":1312,"lineType":1,"content":"己未，復陸扆相。蔡軍以崔珙奔淮南。幽兵寇趙、魏，魏引","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":1314,"lineType":1,"content":"汴兵破之。汴將氏叔琮攻太原，不利。陜州軍亂，牙","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448666736508928"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":1318,"lineType":1,"content":"將殺其帥王珙，立李璠為留後，又殺之，降于汴。青","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":1320,"lineType":1,"content":"州王師範將牛從毅以海州入于淮南。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":1322,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申，相崔𦙍誣殺宰相王搏、樞密使宋道弼、景務脩。朱","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":1324,"lineType":1,"content":"全忠㑹魏軍攻幽之滄、徳州。李克用㧞汴之邢州，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":1326,"lineType":1,"content":"又以三鎮兵攻鎮州，王鎔乞和，乃還。汴將張存敬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":1328,"lineType":1,"content":"攻幽之滄州，又㧞祁州。又敗定州王處直于沙河，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":1330,"lineType":1,"content":"進攻定州，處直以定州降于全忠。罷崔遠相，以裴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":1332,"lineType":1,"content":"贄、裴樞為相，徐彦若觀察青海、中尉兩軍。劉季述、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448662592651276"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":1336,"lineType":1,"content":"王仲先幽帝于東內，令皇太子裕監國。相崔𦙍、張","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":1338,"lineType":1,"content":"𤀹吿難于全忠，全忠自定還汴。䕶駕將孫徳昭、周","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":1340,"lineType":1,"content":"承誨、董彦誅劉季述、王仲先，帝自幽所還政。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":1342,"lineType":1,"content":"辛酉，誅神策使季師度、徐彦回，窘帝故也。降皇太子裕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":1344,"lineType":1,"content":"為徳王，攺元天復。汴將張存敬由含山路㧞李克","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":1346,"lineType":1,"content":"用之河中及晉、絳。朱全忠兼領河中節度，進封梁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":1348,"lineType":1,"content":"王。梁軍大舉攻晉之太原，晉將孟遷以澤入于梁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":1350,"lineType":1,"content":"梁將氏叔琮長驅出團栢屯，軍洞渦。葛從周以趙、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448667705589797"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":1354,"lineType":1,"content":"魏兵入土門，陷承天，㑹天大雨，乃復。宰相崔𦙍受","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":1356,"lineType":1,"content":"全忠旨，逼帝幸東都，未及行，中尉韓全誨以李茂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":1358,"lineType":1,"content":"貞兵劫帝幸鳳翔，罷崔𦙍相。崔𦙍至三原，促全忠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":1360,"lineType":1,"content":"西攻，全忠以鎮兵破華州，由京城西圍鳳翔，又破","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":1362,"lineType":1,"content":"邠州，獲李繼徽以絕其援。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":1364,"lineType":1,"content":"壬戌，帝在鳳翔，封淮南楊行密呉王，兩浙錢鏐越王，俾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":1366,"lineType":1,"content":"救難王室，皆不至。李克用南攻朱全忠，自鳳翔至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":1368,"lineType":1,"content":"河中，命將㧞晉之汾州，進圍太原，不利。全忠自河","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448667705622565"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":1372,"lineType":1,"content":"中復至鳳翔。鄜州節度使李周𢑱以兵援鳳翔，汴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":1374,"lineType":1,"content":"將孔勛乘虛陷鄜州，周𢑱以兵降全忠。邠寧、鄜坊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":1376,"lineType":1,"content":"又入于梁。鳳翔李茂貞逐誅宦氏韓全誨，以解全","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":1378,"lineType":1,"content":"忠之圍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":1380,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，帝還長安，進朱全忠元帥，復崔𦙍相。全忠誅宦氏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":1382,"lineType":1,"content":"七百人，罷陸扆相，以裴樞、王溥為相。青州王師範","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":1384,"lineType":1,"content":"㧞梁之兖州，全忠東攻青州。成都王建寇李茂貞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":1386,"lineType":1,"content":"之秦隴，以脩好于全忠。王師範㑹淮南兵，敗梁軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448670909972520"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":1390,"lineType":1,"content":"于臨淄。梁將楊師原敗青軍于臨昭，王師範以青","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":1392,"lineType":1,"content":"州降。淮南楊行密攻鄂州，荆南成汭救鄂，灃、朗軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":1394,"lineType":1,"content":"乘虛陷江陵。趙匡凝乘虛陷荆州，成汭憤死。岐兵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":1396,"lineType":1,"content":"逼長安，梁軍屯河中。全忠逼帝都洛陽，殺宰相崔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":1398,"lineType":1,"content":"𦙍、六軍使鄭仁規、皇城使王建勲、飛龍使陳班、閤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":1400,"lineType":1,"content":"門使王建襲、客省使王建義、左僕射張𤀹，緩遷故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":1402,"lineType":1,"content":"也。栁璨、崔遠代相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":1404,"lineType":1,"content":"經世之申二千二百六十五。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448669626335270"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":1408,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，唐景文皇帝十六年。東徙至穀水，梁王朱全忠坑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":1410,"lineType":1,"content":"帝侍從三百人。至洛陽，攺元天祐，以張漢瑜為相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":1412,"lineType":1,"content":"楊崇本以邠兵𡨥關，轉全忠西攻，行殺于洛宮，立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":1414,"lineType":1,"content":"輝王祚，是謂哀帝。李克用以本部兵保太原。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":1416,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，梁王全忠逼帝授禪，殺宰相裴樞、崔遠、陸扆及九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":1418,"lineType":1,"content":"王，用張文蔚、楊渉為相，盡出朝廷官吏。太原李克","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":1420,"lineType":1,"content":"用、鳳翔李茂貞、成都王建、襄陽趙匡凝同謀興復。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":1422,"lineType":1,"content":"梁將楊師厚敗趙匡凝于江湄，進㧞襄陽。匡凝將","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448667705638949"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":1426,"lineType":1,"content":"王建武以荆南兵衆降，唐、鄧、復、郢、隨、襄、荆南又入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"于梁，匡凝奔淮南。朱全忠加九錫，總百揆、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":1428,"lineType":1,"content":"天下元","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":1430,"lineType":1,"content":"帥，進封魏王，不受，再逼授禪，殺樞密使蔣元暉、豐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":1432,"lineType":1,"content":"徳庫使應頊、尚食使朱建武及宰相柳璨、太常卿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":1434,"lineType":1,"content":"張廷範、太常少卿裴磵、温變、知制誥張茂昭及皇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":1436,"lineType":1,"content":"后何氏。淮南楊行密卒，子渥繼事。太原李克用㑹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":1438,"lineType":1,"content":"契丹阿保機于雲州，進兵河北。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":1440,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，魏州牙兵亂，朱全忠坑之。進圍幽之滄州，幽人求","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448667705606181"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":1444,"lineType":1,"content":"救于太原，李克用㑹幽軍攻上黨，梁將丁㑹以澤","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":1446,"lineType":1,"content":"潞降。全忠自長蘆還大梁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":1448,"lineType":1,"content":"丁卯，朱全忠代唐命于汴，改國曰梁，元曰𨳩平。薛貽矩、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":1450,"lineType":1,"content":"韓建為相。降帝為濟隂王，徙之曹。河東晉王李克","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":1452,"lineType":1,"content":"用、淮南呉王楊渥、劍南蜀王王建、山東秦王李茂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":1454,"lineType":1,"content":"貞、兩浙越王錢鏐、荆南渤海王高季昌、湖南楚王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":1456,"lineType":1,"content":"馬殷、泉南閩王王審知、廣南南海王劉隱並行唐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":1458,"lineType":1,"content":"年。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448666736476160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":1462,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰，梁攻河東，用于競、張榮為相，殺濟隂王于曹州。荆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":1464,"lineType":1,"content":"南高季昌、湖南馬殷、兩浙錢鏐附于梁。是年，劍南","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":1466,"lineType":1,"content":"王建稱帝成都，國曰蜀，元曰武成。河東李克用、淮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":1468,"lineType":1,"content":"南楊渥、山南李茂貞、泉南王審知、南海劉隱行唐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":1470,"lineType":1,"content":"年。河東李克用卒，子存朂繼。誅亂命李克寧、李存","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":1472,"lineType":1,"content":"顯敗梁軍于潞之三𡸁崗。淮南楊渥為部將張顥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":1474,"lineType":1,"content":"所殺，代立。大將徐温自金陵入，誅顥，立渥弟渭，温","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":1476,"lineType":1,"content":"專制。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448658633359369"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":1480,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳，梁自汴徙都洛陽，交祀天地。趙光逢、杜曉為相。張","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":1482,"lineType":1,"content":"奉以沙州亂。劉知俊以同州叛。丹襄軍亂。泉南王","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":1484,"lineType":1,"content":"審知、南海劉隱附于梁。劉隱卒，弟巖 {"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":1498,"lineType":1,"content":"六月，郢王友珪行弑代","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":1500,"lineType":1,"content":"立，改元鳳厯，殺博王友文于汴。冀王友謙以河中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":1502,"lineType":1,"content":"入于晉。許州軍亂。晉王李存朂敗燕軍于龍崗，進","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":1504,"lineType":1,"content":"圍幽州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":1506,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉，梁六軍殺友珪，立均王友貞于汴，復乾祐三年。晉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":1508,"lineType":1,"content":"李存朂平幽州，獲劉守光及父仁恭以歸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":1510,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌，梁將王殷以徐叛附于呉。晉李存朂開霸府于太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":1512,"lineType":1,"content":"原。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448668795895817"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":1516,"lineType":1,"content":"乙亥，梁攺元貞明。鄴王楊師厚卒，分其地六州為兩鎮，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":1518,"lineType":1,"content":"魏軍遂亂，囚其帥賀徳倫，以六州入于晉。蜀㧞山","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":1520,"lineType":1,"content":"南之秦鳳。階成宮大火。晉李存朂東下，大㑹兵于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":1522,"lineType":1,"content":"魏郊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":1524,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子，梁之河北皆入于晉。趙光逢、鄭珏為相，攻晉不利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":1526,"lineType":1,"content":"蜀攺元通正，㧞山南之隴州。晉李存朂敗 {"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":1548,"lineType":1,"content":"是年，楊渭稱帝淮南，國曰呉，元曰武義。徐温為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448668795879433"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":1552,"lineType":1,"content":"大丞相，都督中外，封東海王。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":1554,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰，梁李琪為相。陳州妖𡨥亂，晉兵入𡨥。呉楊渭卒，弟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":1556,"lineType":1,"content":"溥立。晉存朂㧞梁之同州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":1558,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳，梁攺元龍德，惠王友能以陳叛。呉，改元順義。晉鎮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":1560,"lineType":1,"content":"定亂。契丹犯幽州。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":1562,"lineType":1,"content":"壬午，晉李存朂平鎮定，又敗契丹于易水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":1564,"lineType":1,"content":"癸未，河東晉王存朂稱帝魏州，是謂莊宗，國曰唐，元曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":1566,"lineType":1,"content":"同光，是謂後唐。以豆盧革為相，郭崇韜樞密使。自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448668795928585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":1570,"lineType":1,"content":"魏由鄆而南，敗梁將王彦章于中都，長驅入汴，殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":1572,"lineType":1,"content":"友貞于降國樓，降之為庶人。潞州軍亂，淮南楊溥、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":1574,"lineType":1,"content":"兩浙錢鏐、山南李茂貞、湖南馬殷請附。呉楊溥去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80 ,"pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448668795944969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":1606,"lineType":1,"content":"殺之。荆南逆命，泉南稱附。泉南王延翰為弟王延","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1608,"lineType":1,"content":"鈞所殺，代立。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1610,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥，唐以馮道、崔恊為相。盧臺及浚義軍亂。淮南楊溥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1612,"lineType":1,"content":"復稱帝，攺元乾貞。宰相徐温卒，養子知誥繼事，于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1614,"lineType":1,"content":"金陵稱王。是年，北狄耶律徳光稱帝潢水，國曰契","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1616,"lineType":1,"content":"丹，元曰天顯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":1618,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子，唐以王建立為相，王都以定叛。高季興以荆南入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1620,"lineType":1,"content":"于呉。漢，改元大有。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448646507642914"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":1624,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑，唐以趙鳳為相，安重誨專政。呉改元大和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":1626,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅，唐改元長興。河中兵亂，西川孟知祥、東川董璋連","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1628,"lineType":1,"content":"叛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":1630,"lineType":1,"content":"辛卯，唐以李遇為相，罷安重誨樞密使，以趙延壽、范延","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1632,"lineType":1,"content":"光為樞密使。東西二川相攻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteId },{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未，唐以韓昭𦙍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1662,"lineType":1,"content":"為相。昕州戍軍亂，呉攺元天祚，閩改","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1664,"lineType":1,"content":"元永和。臣李仿弑其君延鈞，立其子昶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1666,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申，唐以馬裔孫為相。以太原石敬瑭移鎮汶陽。石敬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1668,"lineType":1,"content":"瑭自太原入，以北狄耶律徳光稱帝入洛，代唐命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1670,"lineType":1,"content":"改國為晉，元曰天福。以幷州從事桑維翰、趙塋為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1672,"lineType":1,"content":"相。馮道依舊相。輸冀氏之北入于狄。從珂火死于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":1674,"lineType":1,"content":"𤣥武樓。荆南、兩浙稱附。閩王昶誅李倣，改元通文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448668795961353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1678,"lineType":1,"content":"丁酉，晉以李崧為相。河陽張從賓、魏州范延光、滑州符","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1680,"lineType":1,"content":"彦饒、安州盧文進不從命，悉平之。呉大將徐知誥","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1682,"lineType":1,"content":"代呉命于金陵改國曰齊，易號為唐，元曰昇元，復","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1684,"lineType":1,"content":"姓李氏，易名為昇。以宋齊邱、徐玠為左右相，徙其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1686,"lineType":1,"content":"君于丹徒，殺之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1688,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌，晉徙都汴。魏帥范延光服命，封高平王，移鎮汶陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1690,"lineType":1,"content":"北狄耶律徳光改元㑹同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1692,"lineType":1,"content":"已亥，閩亂，連重遇殺其君昶，立其叔父延羲，改元永隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448670557667364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":1696,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子，晉用和凝為相。李金全以安叛，命馬全節以十郡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1698,"lineType":1,"content":"之師平之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1700,"lineType":1,"content":"辛丑，晉帝石敬瑭北廵鄴。安從進以襄叛，安重、宋鎮叛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1702,"lineType":1,"content":"兩浙錢元瓘卒，子𢎞佐繼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":1704,"lineType":1,"content":"壬寅，晉帝石敬瑭終于鄴，從子齊王重貴立，侍魏，將軍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":1706,"lineType":1,"content":"耿延廣專政，始貳于狄。漢劉巖卒，子玢繼，攺元光","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":1708,"lineType":1,"content":"大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":1710,"lineType":1,"content":"癸卯，晉楊光遠以青叛，北狄入𡨥。漢亂，弟晟殺其君玢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448669492117516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":1714,"lineType":1,"content":"代立，改元應乾，再改元乾和。江南李昇卒，子璟繼，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":1716,"lineType":1,"content":"改元保大。宋齊邱、周京為相，平白雲蠻于䖍州。閩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":1718,"lineType":1,"content":"王延羲弟延政亦稱帝建州，國曰殷，元曰天徳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":1720,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰，晉攺元𨳩運，北狄入寇，至于貞博。封晉陽劉知遠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":1722,"lineType":1,"content":"為太原王，劉照為相。閩亂，大將朱文進殺其君延","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":1724,"lineType":1,"content":"羲代立，以福州稱附于晉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":1726,"lineType":1,"content":"乙巳，北狄大入寇晉河朔，至于磁、相。封劉知遠北平王，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":1728,"lineType":1,"content":"罷和凝、桑維翰相，以馮玉為相，李崧知樞密院事。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448685942243366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":1732,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午，晉大將杜重威、季守貞及禆將張彦澤以軍降狄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":1734,"lineType":1,"content":"于中渡。彦澤以兵五百人入汴，為狄清路，幽其君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":1736,"lineType":1,"content":"重貴于𨳩封府署。唐平閩之建州，滅王延政。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":1738,"lineType":1,"content":"丁未正月，契丹耶律德光入汴，滅晉，攺國曰遼。誅張彦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":1740,"lineType":1,"content":"澤，徙其君重貴于北荒政之龍城。二月，北平王劉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":1742,"lineType":1,"content":"知遠稱帝晉陽，年用天福，是謂高祖。五月，契丹潰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":1744,"lineType":1,"content":"于汴，耶律德光留相蕭翰守汴。翰求後唐明宗子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":1746,"lineType":1,"content":"從益立之而去。六月，劉知遠留子崇守太原，南入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448662592733196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":1750,"lineType":1,"content":"汴代命，建國曰漢。用蘇逢吉、蘇禹珪為相，又以竇","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":1752,"lineType":1,"content":"貞固、李濤為相，楊贇、郭威為樞密使。相馮道。李崧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":1754,"lineType":1,"content":"自欒城至。杜重威以魏州拒命。閩國分為三，荆南、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":1756,"lineType":1,"content":"兩浙稱附于漢。呉越錢𢎞佐卒，弟𢎞倧立。狄契丹","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":1758,"lineType":1,"content":"耶律德光還至欒城卒，兄之子几欲代立，歸國廢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":1760,"lineType":1,"content":"德光母，改元天禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":1762,"lineType":1,"content":"戊申，漢改元乾祐。帝知遠終，子周王承祐繼。罷李濤相，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"900","lineNum":1764,"lineType":1,"content":"以楊贇為相。平鄴，誅杜重威。李守貞以河中阻命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448662592749580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":1768,"lineType":1,"content":"王景崇以鳳翔叛，趙思綰以永興抗命，郭威以樞","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":1770,"lineType":1,"content":"密使西伐之。浙東亂，大將胡思進廢其君𢎞倧，立","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":1772,"lineType":1,"content":"其弟俶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":1774,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉，漢之蒲、雍、岐三叛平。契丹寇河北。命郭威以樞密","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":1776,"lineType":1,"content":"使北伐鎮鄴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":1778,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌，漢夷宰相楊贇、侍衛將軍史宏肇、三司使王章族。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":1780,"lineType":1,"content":"賜澶州王殷、魏州郭威、王峻死。十二月，樞密使郭威","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
