{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人也者，暑、寒、晝、夜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448908429164570"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"無不變，雨、風、露、雷無不化，性、情、形、體無不感，走、飛、草、木","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"無不應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"所以目善萬物之色，耳善萬物之聲，鼻善萬物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，口善萬物之味。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"116","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"靈於萬物，不亦宜乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":117,"lineType":8,"content":"觀物篇五十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"118","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"人之所以能靈於萬物者，謂其目能收萬物之色，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"耳能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"收萬物之聲，鼻能收萬物之氣，口能收萬物之味。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"聲、色、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"氣、味者，萬物之體也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"目、耳、鼻、口者，萬人之用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"體無定","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"用，惟變是用；用無定體，惟化是體。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"體用交，而人物之道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448867610329103"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"于是乎備矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"然則人亦物也，聖亦人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"有一物之物，有十物之物，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"百物之物，有千物之物，有萬物之物，有億物之物，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"有兆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"物之物。為兆物之物，豈非人乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"有一人之人，有十人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"人，有百人之人，有千人之人，有萬人之人，有億人之人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"有兆人之人。為兆人之人，豈非聖乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"是知人也者，物之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"至者也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"聖也者，人之至者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"物之至者，始得謂之物之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"物也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"人之至者，始得謂之人之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"夫物之物者，至物","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448878280605708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"人之人者，至人之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"以一至物而當一至人，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"則非聖人而何？人謂之不聖，則吾不信也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"何哉？謂其能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"以一心觀萬心，一身觀萬身，一物觀萬物，一世觀萬世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"者焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂其能以心代天意，口代天言，手代天功，身代","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"天事者焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂其能以上識天時，下盡地理，中盡物情，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"通照人事者焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂其能以彌綸天地，出入造化，進退","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"古今，表裏人物者焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"噫！聖人者，非世世而效聖焉，吾不得而目見之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽然，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448878280638476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"吾不得而目見之，察其心，觀其跡，探其體，潛其用，雖億","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"千萬年，亦可以理知之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"人或吿我曰：天地之外，別有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"天地萬物，異乎此天地萬物，則吾不得而知之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"非惟","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"吾不得而知之也，聖人亦不得而知之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"凡言知者，謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"其心得而知之也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"言言者，謂其口得而言之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"既心尚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"不得而知之，口又惡得而言之乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"以心不可得知而知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"之，是謂妄知也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"以口不可得言而言之，是謂妄言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"吾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"又安能從妄人而行妄知、妄言者乎！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448883233882112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":183,"lineType":8,"content":"觀物篇五十三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：窮理盡性，以至于命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"所以謂之理者，物之理也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"以謂之性者，天之性也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"所以謂之命者，䖏理性者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"以能處理性者，非道而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"是知道為天地之本，天地為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物之本。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"以天地觀萬物，則萬物為萬物；以道觀天地，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"則天地亦為萬物。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"道之道，盡之于天矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道，盡之于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"地矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之道，盡之于萬物矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"194","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"天地萬物之道，盡之于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"人矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"人能知其天地萬物之道所以盡于人者，然後能","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448908429197338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"盡民也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"199","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"天之能盡物，則謂之曰昊天；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"人之能盡民，則謂之曰聖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"謂昊天能異乎萬物，則非所以謂之昊天也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"無有者，非不有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"也，不固有者也，故能大。廣大悉備，而不固為固有者，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"惟三皇乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"329","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"是故知能以道化天下者，天下亦以道歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"所以聖人有言曰：我無為，而民自化；我無事，而民自富；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"我好静，而民自正；我無欲，而民自樸。其斯之謂歟？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448856558305319"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇同仁而異化，五帝同禮而異教，三王同義而異勸，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"五伯同智而異率。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"同禮而異教者，必以徳。以德教民者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"民亦以德歸之，故尚讓。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"337","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"夫讓也者，先人後已之謂也。以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"天下授人而不為輕，若素無之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"339","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"受人之天下而不為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"重，若素有之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"341","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"若素無素有者，謂不已無已有之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"已無已有，則舉一毛以取與于人，猶有貪鄙之心生焉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"而况天下者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"能知其天下之天下非己之天下者，其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"惟五帝乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"是故知能以德教天下者，天下亦以德歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448875332075560"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"所以聖人有言曰：𡸁衣裳而天下治，蓋取諸乾坤。其斯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂歟！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇同性而異化，五帝同情而異教，三王同形而異勸，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"五伯同體而異率。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"同形而異勸者必以功。以功勸民者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"民亦以功歸之，故尚政。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"夫政也者，正也，以正正夫不正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之正莫如利民焉，天下之不正莫如害民","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"能利民者正，則謂之曰王矣；能害民者不正，則謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"曰賊矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"以利除害，安有去王耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"以王去賊，安有弑君耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448867610361871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"是故知王者正也。能以功正天下之不正者，天下亦以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"功歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"所以聖人有言曰：天地革而四時成，湯武革命，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"順乎天而應乎人。其斯之謂歟！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"368","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇同聖而異化，五帝同賢而異教，三王同才而異勸，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"五伯同術而異率。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"同術而異率者必以力。以力率民者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"民亦以力歸之，故尚爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"夫爭也者，爭夫利者也。取以利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"不以義，然後謂之爭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"小爭交以言，大爭交以兵，爭夫強","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"弱者也。猶借夫名焉者，謂之曲直。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"名也者，命物正事之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448874656710693"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"稱也。利也者，飬人成務之具也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"名不以仁，無以守業；利","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"不以義，無以居功。利不以功居，名不以業守，則亂矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"民","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"所以必爭之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"五伯者，借虛名以爭實利者也。帝不足","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"則王，王不足則伯，伯又不足則左袵矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"然則五伯不謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"無功于中國，語其王則未也，過左袵則遠矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"周之東遷，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"文、武之功德於是乎盡矣，猶能維持二十四君，王室不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"絕如綫，秦、楚不敢屠害中原者，由五伯借名之力也。是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"故知能以力率天下者，天下亦以力歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"所以聖人有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448907783225382"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"言曰：眇能視，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人㐫。武人為于大君。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"394","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"斯之謂歟！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"396","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"夫意也者，盡物之性也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"言也者，盡物之情也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"象也者，盡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"物之形也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"數也者，盡物之體也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"401","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"仁也者，盡人之聖也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"禮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"也者，盡人之賢也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"404","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"義也者，盡人之才也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"智也者，盡人之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"術也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"盡物之性者謂之道，盡物之情者謂之徳，盡物之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"形者謂之功，盡物之體者謂之力，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"盡人之聖者謂之化，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"盡人之賢者謂之教，盡人之才者謂之勸，盡人之術者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448908429180954"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之率。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"道、徳、功、力者，存乎體者也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"414","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"化教、勸、率者，存乎用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"416","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"體用之間有變存焉者，聖人之業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"夫變也者，昊天生萬物之謂也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"418","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"權也者，聖人生萬民之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"謂也。非生物，非生民，而得謂之權變乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":425,"lineType":8,"content":"觀物篇五十五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"善化天下者，止于盡道而巳；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"善教天下者，止于盡德而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"已；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"善勸天下者，止于盡功而巳；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"善率天下者，止于盡力","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"以道德功力為化者，乃謂之皇矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"428","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"以道德功力為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448874249846835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"教者，乃謂之帝矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"以道、德功力為勸者，乃謂之王矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"道、德功力為率者，乃謂之伯矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"以化教勸率為道者，乃","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之易矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"以化教勸率為德者，乃謂之書矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"437","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"以化教勸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"率為功者，乃謂之詩矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"以化教勸率為力者，乃謂之春","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"秋矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"441","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"此四者，天地始則始焉，天地終則終焉，終始隨乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"天地者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"夫古今者，在天地之間猶旦暮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"以今觀今，則謂之今","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"矣；以後觀今，則今亦謂之古矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"以今觀古，則謂之古矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448856558354471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"以古自觀，則古亦謂之今矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"是知古亦未必為古，今亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"未必為今，皆自我而觀之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"安知千古之前，萬古之後，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"其人不自我而觀之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"若然，則皇、帝、王、伯者，聖人之時也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"454","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"易、書、詩、春秋者，聖人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"之經也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"時有消長，經有因革。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"時有消長，否泰盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"458","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"經","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"有因革，損益盡之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"否泰盡而體用分，損益盡而心跡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"判。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"體與用分，心與跡判，聖人之事業於是乎備矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"所以自古當世之君天下者，其命有四焉：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰正命，二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448875332091944"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"曰受命，三曰改命，四曰攝命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"467","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"正命者，因而因者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"受命","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"者，因而革者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"攺命者，革而因者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"攝命者，革而革者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"因而因者，長而長者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"因而革者，長而消者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"革而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"因者，消而長者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"477","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"革而革者，消而消者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"革而革者，一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"世之事業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"革而因者，十世之事業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"因而革者，百世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"之事業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"483","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"因而因者，千世之事業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"484","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"可以因則因，可以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"革則革者，萬世之事業也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"一世之事業者，非五伯之道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"十世之事業者，非三王之道而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"百世之事業者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448878280556556"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"非五帝之道而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"492","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"千世之事業者，非三皇之道而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"世之事業者，非仲尼之道而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"是知皇、帝、王、伯者，命世","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"之謂也；仲尼者，不世之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"497","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼曰：殷因于夏禮，所損益可知也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"498","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"周因于殷禮，所損","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"益可知也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"其或繼周者，𨿽百世可知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"如是，則何止於","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"百世而已哉？億千萬世皆可得而知之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"人皆知仲尼之為仲尼，不知仲尼之所以為仲尼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"不欲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"知仲尼之所以為仲尼則已，如其必欲知仲尼之所以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448867610378255"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"爲仲尼，則捨天地将奚之焉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"人皆知天地之為天地，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"知天地之所以爲天地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"不欲知天地之所以為天地則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"已，如其必欲知天地之所以爲天地，則舍動静将奚之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"512","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"焉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"513","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"夫一動一静者，天地之至妙者歟！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"夫一動一静之閒","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"者，天地人之至妙至妙者歟！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"516","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"是故知仲尼之所以能盡","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"三才之道者，謂其行無轍跡也。故有言曰：予欲無言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"518","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天何言哉？四時行焉，百物生焉。其斯之謂歟！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":521,"lineType":8,"content":"觀物篇五十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448856558338087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"孔子賛易，自羲、軒而下；序書，自堯、舜而下；刪詩，自文、武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"而下；修春秋，自桓、文而下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"自羲、軒而下，祖三皇也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"自堯、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"舜而下，宗五帝也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"自文、武而下，子三王也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"528","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"自桓、文而下，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"孫五伯也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"祖三皇，尚賢也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"宗五帝，亦尚賢也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇尚賢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"以道，五帝尚賢以德。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"子三王，尚親也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"孫五伯，亦尚親也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"三王尚親以功，五伯尚親以力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！時之既往，億萬千","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"年；時之未來，亦億萬千年。仲尼中間生而為人，何祖宗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"之寡而子孫之多耶？此所以重賛堯、舜。至禹則曰：禹，吾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448878280687628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"無間然矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼後禹千五百餘年，今之後仲尼又千五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"百餘年，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"544","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽不敢比夫仲尼上賛堯、舜、禹，豈不敢比孟子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"上賛仲尼乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"人謂仲尼惜乎無土，吾獨以為不然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"匹夫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"以百畝為土，大夫以百里為土，諸侯以四境為土，天子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"以四海為土，仲尼以萬世為土。若然，則孟子言自生民","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"以來，未有如夫子，斯亦未為之過矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人不能自富，必待天與其富，然後能富；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"人不能自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，必待天與其貴，然後能貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"若然，則富貴在天也，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448886102769704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"在人也。有求而得之者，有求而不得者矣，是繫乎天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"功徳在人也，不在天也。可脩而得之，不脩則不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"得，是非繫乎天也，繫乎人者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人之能求而得富貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"者，求其可得者也。非其可得者，非所以能求之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"562","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"昧者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"不知，求而得之，則謂其已之能得也，故矜之；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"求而失之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"則謂其人之不與也，故怨之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"如知其已之所以能得，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"之所以能與，則天下安有不知量之人耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"天下至富也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"天子至貴也，豈可妄意求而得之也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽曰天命，亦未始","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448871913685046"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"不由積功累行。聖君艱難以成之，庸君暴虐以壞之，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"天歟？是人歟？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"是知人作之咎，固難逃已；天降之災，禳之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"奚益？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"積功累行，君子常分，非有求而然也。有求而然者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂利乎仁者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"君子安有餘事于其間哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"然而有幸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"有不幸者，始可以語命也已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"夏禹以功有天下，夏桀以虐失天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"殷湯以功有天下，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"殷紂以虐失天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"周武以功有天下，周幽以虐失天下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"三者𨿽時不同，其成敗之形一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"586","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"平王東遷，無功以復","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448878280671244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"王業；赧王西走，無虐以喪王室。威令不逮一小國諸侯，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"仰存于五伯而已，此又奚足道哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"但時無眞王者出焉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽有虛名，與杞、宋其誰曰少異？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"是時也，春秋之作，不亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"宜乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼修經周平王之時，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"書終于晉文侯，詩列為王國風，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋始于魯隱公，易盡于未濟卦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"予非知仲尼者，學為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"禮樂賞罰自天子出，而出自諸侯，天子之重","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"去矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"601","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"宗周之功徳自文武出，而出自幽厲，文武之基息","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448856558387239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。由是犬戎得以侮中國，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"周之諸侯非一，獨晉能攘去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"戎狄，徙王東都洛邑，用存王國，為天下伯者之倡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"606","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"秬鬯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"圭瓚之所錫，其能免乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"傳稱子貢欲去魯吿朔之餼羊，孔子曰：賜也，爾愛其羊，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"我愛其禮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"610","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"是知名存實亡者，猶愈于名實俱亡者矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"禮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽廢而羊存，則後世安知無復行禮者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"晉文公尊王，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽用虛名，猶能力使天下諸侯知有周天子，而不敢以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"兵加之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"及晉之衰也，秦由是敢滅周，斯愛禮之言，信","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448893379870759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"不誣矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"齊景公嘗一日問政于孔子，孔子對曰：君君，臣臣，父父，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"子子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：善哉！信如君不君，臣不臣，父不父，子不子，𨿽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"有粟，吾得而食諸？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"是時也，諸侯僭天子，陪臣執國命，禄","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"去公室，政出私門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"景公自不能上奉周天子，欲其臣下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"奉巳，不亦難乎？厥後齊祚卒為田氏所移。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"夫齊之有田","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"氏者，亦猶晉之有三卿也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"晉之有三𡖖者，亦猶周之有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"五伯也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"631","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"韓、趙、魏之于晉也，既立其功，又分其地；既卑其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448874249912371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"主，又奪其國。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"田氏之于齊也，既得其祿，又專其政；既殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"其君，又移其祚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"其如天下之事，豈無漸乎？履霜之戒，寧","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"無思乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"638","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"傳稱：王者往也，能往天下者，可以王矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"周之衰也，諸侯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"不朝天子久矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"及楚預中國㑹盟，仲尼始進爵為之子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"其于僭王也，不亦陋乎！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"夫以力勝人者，人亦以力勝之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"吳嘗破越，而有輕楚之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"心，及其破楚，又有驕齊之志。貪婪功利，不顧徳義，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"侵侮","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448874249928755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"齊、晉，專以夷狄為事，遂復為越所滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"越又不監之，其後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"復為楚所滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"楚又不監之，其後復為秦所滅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"652","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"秦又不監","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"之，其後復為漢所代。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"654","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"恃強凌弱，與豺虎何以異乎？非所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"以謂之中國義理之師也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"宋之為國也，爵高而力卑者乎！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"盟不度徳，㑹不量力，區","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"區與諸侯並驅中原，恥居其後，其于伯也，不亦難乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"659","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"周之同姓諸侯而克永世者，獨有燕在焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"燕處北陸之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"地，去中原特遠，茍不隨韓、趙、魏、齊、楚較利刃，爭虛名，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018487214850090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"足以養徳待時，而觀諸侯之變。秦𨿽虎狼，亦未易加害，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"延十五六年後，天下事未可知也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"中原之地，方九千里，古不加多，而今不加少，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"然而有祚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"長祚短、地大地小者，攻守異故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"669","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"自三代以降，漢、唐為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"盛，秦界于周、漢之間矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"秦始盛于𥡆公，中于孝公，終于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"始皇。起于西夷，遷于岐山，徙于咸陽，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"兵瀆宇內，血流天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"下，幷吞四海，更革古今。𨿽不能比徳三代，非晉、隋可同","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"年而語也。其祚之不永，得非用法太酷，殺人之多乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"676","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018487214866474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"以仲尼序書，終于秦誓一事，其㫖不亦遠乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"679","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"夫好生者，生之徒也；好殺者，死之徒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"周之好生也以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"義，漢之好生也亦以義；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"秦之好殺也以利，楚之好殺也","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"亦以利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"周之好生也以義，而漢且不及；秦之好殺也以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"利，而楚又過之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"686","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道，人之情，又奚擇于周、秦、漢、楚哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"擇乎善惡而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"是知善也者，無敵于天下，而天下共善","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"之；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"690","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"惡也者，亦無敵于天下，而天下亦共惡之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道，人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"之情，又奚擇于周、秦、漢、楚哉？擇乎善惡而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018487214882858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7619018487214899242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極經世書卷十一，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448883234045952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":3,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定四庫全書","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"3","lineNum":4,"lineType":4,"content":"皇極經世書卷十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":5,"lineType":7,"content":"宋邵雍撰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":7,"lineType":8,"content":"觀物篇五十七","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"6","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"昔者孔子語堯舜，則曰𡸁衣裳而天下治；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"語湯武，則曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"順乎天而應乎人。斯言可以該古今帝王受命之理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"堯禪舜以徳，舜禪禹以功。以德，帝也；以功，亦帝也。然而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"德下一等，則入于功矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"湯伐桀以放，武伐紂以殺。以放，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"王也；以殺，亦王也。然而放下一等，則入于殺矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"是知時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448886102868008"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"有消長，事有因革，前聖後聖，非出乎一途哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"天與人相為表裏，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"天有隂陽，人有邪正。邪正之由，繫乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"上之所好也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"上好德則民用正；上好佞，則民用邪。邪正","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"之由，有自來矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽聖君在上，不能無小人，是難其為小","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"人；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"𨿽庸君在上，不能無君子，是難其為君子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"自古聖君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"之盛，未有如唐堯之世，君子何其多耶！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"時非無小人也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"是難其為小人，故君子多也。所以𨿽有四凶，不能肆其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"惡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"自古庸君之盛，未有如商紂之世，小人何其多耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448893379919911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"非無君子也，是難其為君子，故小人多也，所以𨿽有三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"仁，不能遂其善。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"是知君擇臣、臣擇君者，是繫乎人也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"得臣、臣得君者，是非繫乎人也，繫乎天者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"賢愚，人之本性，利害，民之常情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"虞舜陶于河濵，傅說築","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"于巖下，天下皆知其賢，而百執事不為之舉者，利害使","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"之然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"吁！利害叢于中，而矛戟森于外，又安知有虞舜","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"之聖而傅說之賢哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"河濱非禪位之所，巖下非求相之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"方。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"昔也在億萬人之下，而今也在億萬人之上，相去一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909343391759"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"何遠之甚耶！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"然而必此云者，貴有名者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：坎，有孚，維心亨，行有尚。中正行險，往且有功，𨿽危","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"無咎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"能自信故也。伊尹以之。是知古之人患名過實者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"53","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"其間有幸與不幸者，𨿽聖人力有不及者矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"伊","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"尹行冢宰，居責成之地，借使避放君之名，豈曰不忠乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"則天下之事去矣，又安能正嗣君成終始之大忠者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
