{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"吁！若委寄于匪人，三年之間，其如嗣君何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"58","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"則天下之事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"亦去矣，又安有伊尹也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"坎有孚，維心亨。不亦近之乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448882889932863"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：由豫，大有得，勿疑，朋盍簮。剛健主豫，動而有應，羣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"疑乃亡，能自強故也。周公以之是知聖人不能使人無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"謗，能處謗者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"65","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"周公居總，已當任重之地，借使避滅親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"之名，豈曰不孝乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"則天下之事去矣，又安能保嗣君成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"終始之大孝乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"吁！若委寄于匪人，七年之間，其如嗣君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"則天下之事亦去矣，又安有周公也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"由豫，大有得，勿","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"疑，朋盍簮，不亦近之乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天下将治，則人必尚行也。天下将亂，則人必尚言也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448920819253298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"尚行，則篇實之風行焉，尚言，則詭譎之風行焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"天下将","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"治，則人必尚義也；天下将亂，則人必尚利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"尚義，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"謙讓之風行焉，尚利，則攘奪之風行焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"三王，尚行者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"也；五伯，尚言者也。尚行者，必入于義也，尚言者，必入于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"利也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"義利之相去，一何遠之若是耶？是知言之于口，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"若行之于身；行之于身，不若盡之于心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"86","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"言之于口，人得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"而聞之；行之于身，人得而見之；盡之于心，神得而知之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"人之聰明猶不可欺，况神之聦明乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"89","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"是知無愧于口，不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448886102851624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"若無愧于身；無愧于身，不若無愧于心。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"無口過易，無身","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"過難；無身過易，無心過難。心既無過，何難之有？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"吁！安得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"無心過之人而與之語心哉？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"是知聖人所以能立無過","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"之地者，謂其善事于心者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":119,"lineType":8,"content":"觀物篇五十八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼曰：韶盡美矣，又盡善也。武，盡美矣，未盡善也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"管仲相桓公，霸諸侯，一匡天下，民到于今受其賜。微管","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"仲，吾其被髮左袵矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"是知武王雖不逮舜之盡善盡美，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448884202749991"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"以其解天下之倒懸，則下于舜一等耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"桓公𨿽不逮武","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"之應天順人，以其霸諸侯，一匡天下，則高于狄亦遠矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"以武比舜，則不能無過；比桓，則不能無功。以桓比狄，則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"不能無功，比武，則不能無過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"110","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"漢氏宜立乎桓、武之間矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"是時也，非㑹天下之民厭秦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"之暴且甚，雖十劉季、百子房，其如人心之未易何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"且古","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"今之時則異也，而民好生惡死之心非異也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"自古殺人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"之多，未有如秦之甚，天下安有不厭之乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"夫殺人之多，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448877265469440"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"不必以刃，謂天下之人無生路可趍也，而又况以刃多","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"殺天下之人乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"秦二世，萬乘也，求為黔首而不能得；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"漢劉季，匹夫也，免","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"為元首而不能已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"124","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"萬乘與匹夫，相去有間矣，然而有時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"而代之者，謂其天下之利害有所懸之耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道，非祸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"萬乘而福匹夫也，謂其祸無道而福有道也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"人之情，非","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"去萬乘而就匹夫也，謂其去無道而就有道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"萬乘與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"匹夫，相去有間矣，然而有時而代之者，謂其直以天下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448877265502208"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"之利害有所懸之耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"日既沒矣，月既望矣，星不能不希矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"非星之希，是星難","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"乎其為光矣。能為其光者，不亦希乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"漢、唐既創業矣，吕、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"武既擅權矣，臣不能不希矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"非臣之希，是臣難乎其為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"忠矣。能為其忠者，不亦希乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"是知成天下事易，死天下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"事難；死天下事易，成天下事難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"茍能成之，又何計乎死","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"與生也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"如其不成，𨿽死奚益？况其有正與不正者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"其死于不正，孰若生于正？與其生于不正，孰若死于正？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448921712672795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"在乎忠與智者之一擇焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"死固可惜，貴乎成天下之事","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"也。如其敗天下之事，一死奚以塞責？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"生固可愛，貴乎成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之事也。如其敗天下之事，一生何以收功？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"噫！能成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之事，又能不失其正而生者，非漢之留侯、唐之梁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"公而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"微斯二人，則漢唐之祚或幾乎移矣，豈若虛生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"虛死者焉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"夫虛生虛死者，譬之蕭艾，忠與智者不遊乎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"其間矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":197,"lineType":8,"content":"觀物篇五十九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448885079359514"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"仲尼曰：善人為邦百年，亦可以勝殘去殺矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"誠哉是言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"也。自極亂至于極治，必三變矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"三皇之法無殺，五伯之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"法無生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"伯一變，至于王矣，王一變，至于帝矣，帝一變，至","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"于皇矣。其于生也，非百年而何？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"170","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"是知三皇之世如春，五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"帝之世如夏，三王之世如秋，五伯之世如冬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"如春，温如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"也；如夏，燠如也；如秋，凄如也；如冬，冽如也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏秋冬者，昊天之時也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"易、書、詩、春秋者，聖人之經也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"天時不差，則歲功成矣；聖經不忒，則君徳成矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"天有常","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448884202831911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"時，聖有常經。行之正則正矣，行之邪則邪矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"邪正之間，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"有道在焉。行之正則謂之正道，行之邪則謂之邪道。邪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"正之由人乎？由天乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"天由道而生，地由道而成，物由道而行，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"天地人物則異","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"也，其于由道一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"夫道也者，道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"道無形，行之則見于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"事矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"189","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"如道路之道，坦然使千億萬年行之，人知其歸者","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"191","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：君子道長，則小人道消，君子道消則小人道長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"長","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448883234144256"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"者是則消者非也；消者是則長者非也。何以知正道、邪","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"道之然乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"吁！賊夫人之論也。不曰君行君事、臣行臣事、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"父行父事、子行子事、夫行夫事、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"妻行妻事、君子行君子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"事、小人行小人事、中國行中國事、僣竊行僣竊事，謂之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"正道；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"君行臣事、臣行君事、父行子事、子行父事、夫行妻","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"事、妻行夫事、君子行小人事、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"小人行君子事、中國行僣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"竊事、僣竊行中國事，謂之邪道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"至于三代之世治，未有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"不治人倫之為道也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"三代之世亂，未有不亂人倫之為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448884202799143"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"210","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"後世之慕三代之治世者，未有不正人倫者也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"後","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"世之慕三代之亂世者，未有不亂人倫者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"自三代而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"下，漢唐為盛，未始不由治而興，亂而亡，况其不盛于漢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"唐者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"其興也，又未始不由君道盛，父道盛，夫道盛，君","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"子之道盛，中國之道盛；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"其亡也，又未始不由臣道盛，子","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"道盛，妻道盛，小人之道盛，夷狄之道盛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"噫！二道對行，何","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"故治世少而亂世多耶？君子少而小人多耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：豈不知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"陽一而隂二乎？天地尚由是道而生，况其人與物乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"人","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448877265534976"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"者，物之至靈者也。物之靈未若人之靈，尚由是道而生，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"又况人靈于物者乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"是知人亦物也，以其至靈，故特謂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":279,"lineType":8,"content":"觀物篇六十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"日經天之元，月經天之㑹，星經天之運，辰經天之世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"日經日，則元之元可知之矣；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448882890211391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"天有四時，一時四月，一月四十日，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"大數不足而小數常盈者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"六十四分而二百五十六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"故離坎為生物之主，以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448933733384230"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"離四陽，坎四隂，故生物者必四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"317","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽之四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"十共為二百五十六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"319","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"是以八卦用六爻，乾坤主之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"320","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"六爻用四位，離坎主之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"故天之昏曉不生物，而日中","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"生物；地之南北不生物，而中央生物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"323","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"體數何為者也？生物者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"324","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"用數何為者也？運行者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"天以獨運，故以用數自相乘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"為生物之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"天數三，故六六而义六之，是以乾之策二百一十有六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"地數兩，故十二而十二之，是以坤之策百四十有四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"乾用九，故三其八為二十四而九之，亦二百一十六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"坤以十二之二十四，六之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"六之一與半為乾之餘分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"則乾得二百五十二，坤得一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448920005328933"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"百八也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"348","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"體有三百八十四，而用止于三百六十，何也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"以乾坤離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"坎之不用也。乾坤離坎之不用，何也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤離坎之不用，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"所以成三百六十之用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"夫惟不變，是以能變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"357","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"數之嬴則何用也？乾全用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"乾全用者，何也？陽主嬴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"離坎用半，何也？離東","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909343686671"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"坎西，當隂陽之半，為春秋晝夜之門也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"或用乾，或用離","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"坎，何也？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"主嬴分而言之，則陽侵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，晝侵夜，故用離坎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"隂主虛，故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"坤全不用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"375","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"是以天之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"南全見，而北全不見，東西各半見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"然用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"數不過乎寅，交數不過乎申也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":411,"lineType":2,"content":"或離當卯，坎當酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"乾四十八，兌三十，離二十四，震十，坤十二，艮二十，坎三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448893380132903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"十六，巽四十。乾三十六，坤十二，離、兌、巽二十八，坎、艮、震","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"二十。乾四十八而四分之，一分為隂所尅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"坤四十八而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"四分之，一為所尅之陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"388","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"故乾得三十六，而坤得十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主進，是以進之為三百六十日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"隂主消，是以十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"月消十二日也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"陽四卦十二爻，八陽四隂，以三十六乘其陽，以二十四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"乘其隂，則三百八十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者，星也。厯紀之數，其肇於此乎？方者，土也。畫州井地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448893380116519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，其仿於此乎？蓋圓者，河圖之數；方者，洛書之文。故","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"犧、文因之而造易，禹、箕敍之而作範也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"圓數有一，方數有二，奇偶之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"400","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"六即一也，十二即二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者徑一圍三，重之則六。方者徑一圍四，重之則八也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"403","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"天圓而地方，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"方者分一而為四，分四而為十六，皆自然之道","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者一變則生六，去一則五也；二變則生十二，去二則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"十也；三變則生十八，去三則十五也；四變則二十四，去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"四則二十也。五變則三十，去五，則二十五也。六變則三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448885746483209"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"十六，去六，則三十也。是以存之則六六，去之則五五也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"五則四而存一也；四則三而存一也；二則一而存一也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"故一生二，去一則一也。二生三，去一則二也。三生四，去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"一則三也。四生五，去一，則四也。是故二以一為本，三以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"二為本，四以三為本，五以四為本，六以五為本。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":497,"lineType":2,"content":"更思之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"方者，一變而為四，四生八，幷四而為十二。八生十二，幷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"八而為二十。十二生十六，幷十二而為二十八。十六生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"二十，并十六而為三十六也。一生三，并而為四也。十二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448882890195007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"生二十，幷而為三十二也。二十八生三十六，幷而為六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":509,"lineType":2,"content":"更思之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"一役二，以生三，三去其一，則二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"體以用為本，故去四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"圓者本一，方者本四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"故蓍存一而卦去四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"523","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍之用數七，幷其餘分，亦存一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912967303231"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"掛其一，亦去一之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍數不以六而以七，何也？幷其餘分也。去其餘分則六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"故策數三十六也。是以五十者，六十四卦閏歲之策也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"其用四十有九，六十四卦一歲之策也。歸奇掛一，猶一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"歲之閏也。卦直去四者，何也？天變而地效之，是以蓍去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"一則卦去四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍之用數，掛一以象三，其餘四十八，則一卦之策也。四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"其十二，為四十八也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"十二去三而用九，四三十二，所去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912958898239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"之策也，四九三十六，所用之策也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"以當乾之三十六陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"爻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"539","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"十二去五而用七，四五二十，所去之策也，四七二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"十八，所用之策也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"以當兌、離之二十八陽爻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"十二去","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"六而用六，四六二十四，所去之策也，四六二十四，所用","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"之策也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"以當坤之二十四隂爻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"十二去四而用八，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"四十六，所去之策也，四八三十二，所用之策也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"548","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"以當艮、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"坎之二十四爻，幷上卦之八隂為三十二爻也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"是故七、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"九為陽，六、八為隂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"九者陽之極數，六者隂之極數，數","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448919875502121"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"極則反，故為卦之變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"震、巽無策者，以當不用之數。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"以剛為徳，故柔者不見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"地以柔為體，故剛者不生。是以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"震巽無策也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":619,"lineType":2,"content":"或先艮後兌、離。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"乾用九，故其策九也。四之者，以應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"四時，一時九十日也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"坤用六，故其策亦六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"竒數四，有一，有二，有三，有四；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"策數四，有六，有七，有八，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"九。合而為八數，以應方數之八變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"567","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"歸奇合掛之數有六，謂五與四四也，九與八八也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"五與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"四八也，九與四八也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"五與八八也，九與四四也，以應圓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448920005361701"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"數之變六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"奇數極於四而五不用，策數極於九而十不用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"五則一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"也，十則二也，故去五十而用四十九也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"奇不用五，策不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"用十，有無之極也，以况自然之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍數全，故陽策三十六與二十八合之為六十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"數去其四，故隂策二十四與三十二合之為五十六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"九進之為三十六，皆陽數也，故為陽中之陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"七進之為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八，先陽而後隂也，故為陽中之隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"六進之為二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448925269196800"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"四，皆隂數也，故為隂中之隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"八進之為三十二，先隂而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"後陽也，故為隂中之陽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍四進之則百，卦四進之則百二十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"百則十也，百二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"則十二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"歸竒合掛之數，得五與四四，則策數四九也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"得九與八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"八，則策數四六也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"得五與八八、得九與四八，則策數皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"四七也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"得九與四四、得五與四八，則策數皆四八也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"為八者，二變以應艮與坎也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"605","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"五與四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"四，去掛一之數，則四八三十二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"九與八八，去掛一之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"數，則四六二十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"五與八八、九與四八，去掛一之數，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"則四五二十也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"故去其三、四、五、六之數，以成九、八、七、六之策","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"天一地二，天三地四，天五地六，天七地八，天九地十。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448923998339081"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"者，數之始，而非數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"622","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"故二二為四，三三為九，四四為十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"六，五五為二十五，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"百則十也，十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"則一也，亦不可變也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"是故數去其一而極于九，皆用其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"變者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"八八六十四，卦數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"九九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"八十一，𤣥範之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"大衍之數，其算法之源乎？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"是以算數之起，不過乎方圓","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448919875534889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"曲直也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"乘數，生數也。除數，消數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"算法雖多，不出乎此","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"易之大衍，何數也？聖人之𠋣數也。天數二十五，合之為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"五十。地數三十，合之為六十。故曰五位相得而各有合","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"也。五十者，蓍之數也。六十者，卦之數也。五者，蓍之小衍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故五十為大衍也。八者，卦之小成，則六十四為大成","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"五十分之則為十，若三天兩之則為六，兩地又兩之則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448906172743714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"為四，此天地分太極之數也。天之變六，六其六得三十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"六，為乾一爻之數也。積六爻之策，共得二百一十有六，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"為乾之策；六其四，得二十四，為坤一爻之策。積六爻之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"數，共得一百四十有四，為坤之策。積二篇之策，乃萬有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"一千五百二十也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"陽得隂而生，隂得陽而成，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"656","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"故蓍數四而九，卦數六而十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"猶幹支之相錯，幹以六終，而支以五終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"卦有六十四，而用止六十者，何也？六十卦者，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"660","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"三百六十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912958914623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"爻也，故甲子止于六十也。六甲天道窮矣，是以策數應","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"之，三十六與二十四，合之則六十也。三十二與二十八，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"合之亦六十也。乾四十八，坤十二，震二十，巽四十，離、兌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"三十二，坎、艮二十八，合之亦六十也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"三四十二也，二六亦十二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"二其十二，二十四也，三八","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"亦二十四也，四六亦二十四也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"669","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"三其十二，三十六也，四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"九亦三十六也，六六亦三十六也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"四其十二，四十八也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"三其十六亦四十八也，六八亦四十八也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"五其十二，六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912967319615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"十也；三其二十亦六十也；六其十亦六十也。皆自然之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"相符也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"此蓋隂數分其陽數耳，是以相因也。如月初一分作十二也，二十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":761,"lineType":2,"content":"四氣、七十二候之數，亦可因","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":763,"lineType":2,"content":"以明之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"四九三十六也，六六三十六也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"陽六而乂，兼隂六之半，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"是以九也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"683","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"故以二卦言之，隂陽各三也；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"以三爻言之，天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"地人各二也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"686","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽之中各有天地人，天地人之中各有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽，故參天兩地而倚數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"易有真數，三而已。參天者，三三而九；兩地者，倍三而六。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909515522100"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"參天兩地而倚數，非天地之正數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"691","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"𠋣者，擬也，擬天地","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"正數而生也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"693","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"易之數窮天地終始。或曰：天地亦有終始乎？曰：既有消","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"長，豈無終始？天地雖大，是亦形器，乃二物也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"易之生數一十二萬九千六百，總為四千三百二十，比","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"696","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"消長之大數，演三十年之辰數，卽其數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"697","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"歲三百六十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"日，得四千三百二十辰，以三十乘之，得其數矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"699","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"凡甲子、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午為世首，此為經世之數，始于日甲、月子、星甲、辰子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912958931007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：此經世日甲之數，月子、星甲、辰子從之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"十、百、千、萬、億為奇，天之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"704","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"十二、百二十、千二百、萬二","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"千、億二萬為偶，地之數也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"十干，天也；十二支，地也。支干配天地之用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"干者，幹之義，陽也；支者，枝之義，隂也。干十而支十二，是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"陽數中有隂，隂數中有陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"陽數一，衍之為十，十干之類是也。隂數二，衍之為十二，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支、","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"711","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909515538484"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"陽無十，故不足于後；隂無一，故不足于首。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"714","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"陽數於三百六十上盈，隂數於三百六十上縮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"體四而變六，兼神與氣也。氣變必有，故三百六十也。氣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"以六變，體以四分。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之交十之三，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事為之極幾十之七，則可以正矣。蓋夏至之日止于","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"六十，兼之以晨昏分，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":825,"lineType":2,"content":"可辨邑矣，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"庶幾乎十之七也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"正音律。數行至于七而止者，以夏至之日出於寅而入","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448933733416998"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"於戌，亥、子、丑三時，則日入於地而目無所見。此三數不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"行者，所以比於三時也。故生物之數亦然，非數之不行","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"727","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"有數而不見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"天下之數出於理，違乎理則入於術。世人以數而入術，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"故失於理也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"730","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"太極既分，兩儀立矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"陽下交於隂，隂上交於陽，四象生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"陽交於隂，隂交於陽，而生天之四象；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"剛交於柔，柔交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"於剛，而生地之四象。於是八卦成矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"736","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦相錯，然後萬","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448912958947391"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"物生焉。是故一分為二，二分為四，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"四分為八，八分為十","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"六，十六分為三十二，三十二分為六十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰分隂分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，迭用柔剛，易六位而成章也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"十分為百，百分為千，千","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"分為萬，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"745","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"猶根之有幹，幹之有枝，枝之有葉，愈大則愈少，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"愈細則愈繁，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"747","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"合之斯為一，衍之斯為萬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"748","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"是故乾以分之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"坤以翕之，震以長之，巽以消之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"長則分，分則消，消則翕","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤定位也，震巽一交也，兌離坎艮再交也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"753","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"故震陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"少而隂尚多也，巽隂少而陽尚多也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"兌離陽浸多也，坎","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448906172760098"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"艮隂浸多也。是以辰與火不見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣分而隂陽判，得陽之多者為天，得隂之多者為地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"759","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"是故隂陽半而形質具焉，隂陽偏而性情分焉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"形質又","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"分，則多陽者為剛也，多隂者為柔也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"762","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"性情又分，則多陽","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"者陽之極也，多隂者隂之極也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"764","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"兌離巽得陽之多者也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"765","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"艮坎震得隂之多者也。是以為天地用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"乾陽極，坤隂","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"極，是以不用也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"768","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤之名位不可易也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"769","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離名可易而位不可易也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"震","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448909515489332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"巽位可易而名不可易也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"773","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"兌艮名與位皆可易也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"774","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"離肖","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"乾，坎肖坤，中孚肖乾，頤肖離，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"小過肖坤，大過肖坎，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"777","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"是以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、坤、離、坎、中孚、頤、大過、小過皆不可易者也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"779","lineNum":889,"lineType":1,"content":"離在天而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"當夜，故陽中有隂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"坎在地而當晝，故隂中有陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"震","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"始交隂而陽生，巽始消陽而隂生。兌陽長也，艮隂長也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"震兌在天之隂也，巽艮在地之陽也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"785","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"故震兌上隂而下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，巽艮上陽而下隂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"787","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"天以始生言之，故隂上而陽下，交","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"泰之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"地以既成言之，故陽上而隂下，尊卑之位也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426448923998322697"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤定上下之位，離坎列左右之門，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"792","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之所闔闢，日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"月之所出入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
